economy.zh:
全球市场在伊朗战与AI抛售的双重阴影中迎来剧烈分化：油价因“最后机会”谈判而反复，石油巨头大赚的财报却招致白宫抨击；美国以欧元为工具干预日元，外汇暗流涌动。与此同时，中国A股在去杠杆后逆势反击，中港金融互联互通加速，呈现独立于美股的叙事。

- 伊朗局势成为最大变量。特朗普称美伊谈判是“最后机会”，但德黑兰否认，油价震荡走高。BP第二季度利润翻倍，沙特阿美净利增33%，而特朗普斥责大型石油“赚太多”，原油供应与政治博弈交织。[特朗普](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/us-iran-war-trump-hormuz.html) [BP](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/bp-2q-earnings-oil-iran-war.html) [沙特](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/saudi-aramco-earnings-2q-oil-iran-war.html)
- 美国悄然干预日元。媒体称华盛顿通过出售欧元支撑日元，而非直接买日元，意在避免冲击美债市场。这是美国财政部罕见的直接介入，凸显日元无序贬值的全球风险。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/cnbc-daily-open-yen-intervention-dollar-euro-fx.html) [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/03/business/us-japan-yen-intervention.html)
- 欧洲屏息静气。特朗普取消对伊打击后布伦特原油一度跌超7%，欧洲股市与债市同步反弹；但ECB研究显示，伊朗战争对欧元区消费的负面冲击显著，滞胀担忧并未消散。[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/oil-prices-fall-europe-stock-markets-donald-trump-iran-us-brent-crude) [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPSEhIQmRnRGRhT3FNNFBJcWdIeFd4THBVYnMtM3d6ODFUZnBWcU9VVVlKdjNBNTlhbWpYX0dBTXNQb2JOTmdNT0NSQ2NaMkVzWjJSVk9EV3RWajB1U05YZURnSWpvbjJNdy1QTVNad2tFbnloaVEzejZUM2NsU19PUTMzNFJZMk5udkViUkxXeGRJdGp2NG1lQVd3dGxEa004VkVsTWJaVQ)
- 中国股市大反转。8月4日创业板指收涨5.64%，算力硬件、CPO等板块爆发，与上周全球AI抛售形成鲜明对比。此前两融余额7月降14%至2.59万亿元，券商却认为A股仅是调整，8月有望修复。[收评](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ycVNUWm5wOTV0WFhIeWU2M2VqQ2hvVHc3bENBdFQzQ203TmxLelJucFFiejBTRmk1cC1iNG1ydVZDdXVfZXU3YngxUVpfZXhwdG95Nm5EMFVfVkNFd3c) [杠杆](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362797/china-stock-traders-cut-leveraged-positions-14-july-amid-tech-sell)
- 中港金融“拆墙”。官方宣布更多互联互通措施，港交所推出五年期中国国债期货，mBridge跨境CBDC网络试图挑战SWIFT，人民币资产通道持续拓宽。[措施](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNRU5PSVQ3amNQS0VnQ2VSOEZaX2pWZGJfcjFHbUJBRFN6ejc4YmlpUGhwdkFtMUxVWm03U3U4LTY2UG9uMTlxd05pZ0pnRDVQYkEtQ0FKeWRwS056cW1sb2FOWmtvVTN0NnJNQ05US0dWSEx4djdVaW1abjdydlNVMDJDeHo3cDFKMjJzMlB4QUpNckVsUnYzVURyc25zUQ) [国债期货](https://news.google.) [mBridge](https://news.google.)
- 巨头动作连连。阿斯利康与百时美施贵宝商谈近4000亿美元合并，拟打造全球第四大药企；汇丰二季度业绩超预期，宣布10亿美元回购，资本充足信号明显。[阿斯利康](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/astrazeneca-talks-bristol-myers-squibb-merger-pharmaceuticals) [汇丰](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362872/hsbc-sets-aside-us1-billion-first-share-buy-back-october)
- 中国内需分化。可口可乐、联合利华等跨国巨头在华销售强劲，但本土电动车三杰7月交付量齐降；药明康德上半年净利增33.7%，减肥药与CDMO需求托底。[消费](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362787/multinational-giants-defy-chinas-sluggish-retail-market-strong-2026-sales) [EV](https://www.scmp.com/plus/business/china-evs/article/3362799/chinese-ev-sales-falter-home-growth-slows) [药明](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362817/chinese-biotech-giant-wuxi-apptec-sees-first-half-earnings-surge-amid-us-scrutiny)

**后续观察**：市场正处在两个十字路口：伊朗谈判若破裂，油价与通胀预期将再度燃爆；若达成协议，石油板块和避险资产面临重定价。日元干预的“欧元隐身衣”能穿多久，取决于美债市场的压力阀。中国股市的反弹能否延续，则需观察AI产业周期与增量政策能否形成合力。
economy.en:
Last 24 hours were dominated by whipsawing oil prices, fresh mega-cap earnings, and a sharp reversal in Chinese equities. The market is trying to price a contradictory geopolitical picture: Trump cancelled planned strikes on Iran, crude plunged, and then Trump called new negotiations Tehran's 'last chance' while Tehran denied talks are happening.

- Oil is the macro tail risk. Brent fell 5% to $83.47 on Monday after Trump called off Iran strikes, only to firm again after his 'last chance' warning; the Iran war is now a five-month conflict. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/oil-prices-fall-europe-stock-markets-donald-trump-iran-us-brent-crude), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/us-iran-war-trump-hormuz.html)
- Oil supermajors are harvesting the crisis: BP's profit more than doubled and Saudi Aramco's second-quarter profit jumped 33%, while Trump blasted Big Oil for 'making too much money' off higher fuel prices. [CNBC BP](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/bp-2q-earnings-oil-iran-war.html), [CNBC Aramco](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/saudi-aramco-earnings-2q-oil-iran-war.html)
- Currency markets show hidden stress. Reports suggest Washington sold euros, not Treasuries, to fund a yen intervention, and the NYT explains why the US joined Japan to prop up the yen. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/cnbc-daily-open-yen-intervention-dollar-euro-fx.html), [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/03/business/us-japan-yen-intervention.html)
- HSBC beat estimates on net interest income and fees, and set aside $1bn for its first buyback since October, signalling confidence in Asia-linked earnings. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/hsbc-profit-beats-estimates-higher-net-interest-income-fees.html), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362872/hsbc-sets-aside-us1-billion-first-share-buy-back-october)
- China markets flipped from global AI-selloff contagion to a powerful rebound: ChiNext surged 5.64% on Tuesday after a 14% July cut in margin leverage and broker forecasts for a tech/chip rebound. [A-share close](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ycVNUWm5wOTV0WFhIeWU2M2VqQ2hvVHc3bENBdFQzQ203TmxLelJucFFiejBTRmk1cC1iNG1ydVZDdXVfZXU3YngxUVpfZXhwdG95Nm5EMFVfVkNFd3c), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362797/china-stock-traders-cut-leveraged-positions-14-july-amid-tech-sell), [SCMP brokers](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362812/why-chinese-brokers-forecast-share-tech-and-chip-rebound)
- Europe is absorbing the war's damage: ECB research says the Iran war hit euro area consumption especially hard, while July PMIs show Germany leading a factory rebound; UK inflation risk is more about natural gas than oil. [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPSEhIQmRnRGRhT3FNNFBJcWdIeFd4THBVYnMtM3d6ODFUZnBWcU9VVVlKdjNBNTlhbWpYX0dBTXNQb2JOTmdNT0NSQ2NaMkVzWjJSVk9EV3RWajB1U05YZURnSWpvbjJNdy1QTVNad2tFbnloaVEzejZUM2NsU19PUTMzNFJZMk5udkViUkxXeGRJdGp2NG1lQVd3dGxEa004VkVsTWJaVQ), [Trans.INFO](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE9pLWJtUC1Pb0hxaWxWd01MM3FLN0FiQTV6ZmE4Tkw5aWhqa0FHUk1HQzFmaEpMRGZJX3BNM1ZSb0ZVTzVvTUtYQ3pUM0hpQ3JC), [Market Minute](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPV0ZEdzc1bmFiT2ZHdWxzVEQ4VUUtV2NmVDRTQmtfa1A1bWZQNWdTTHozZjg3NS1BZFJQMDJTZUVJNnNEMjdsSzl5bURtdEdFZzZOSkNjN2VpUGtLc2JiWTVrZ0tSLTdCelh1TEh6aDZ1R1pkaDd4ZDFKd2RZdVhNa2pVSFNmNm55X3J4bDhZdmNJZHUyelFlWjMxNEk3MU1jbW82NUFmYw)
- Corporate stories are moving markets: AstraZeneca lost more than £17bn in value after Bristol Myers Squibb merger talks, while Grab raised its outlook on AI-driven logistics. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/astrazeneca-talks-bristol-myers-squibb-merger-pharmaceuticals), [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/grab-earnings-ai-forecast-cfo-.html)

[Fed insider-lending](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731b.htm), [Fed mutual banks](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731a.htm)

society.zh:
过去24小时，全球社会新闻被冲突、气候与市场干预共同牵引：缅甸民主象征在长期隔离后露面，加沙停火协议反而伴随更多伤亡，欧洲河流干涸，美日联手护市。与此同时，中文互联网社区正遭遇一波低质博彩信息刷屏。

- [昂山素季近照曝光](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1e1d5j6660o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：缅甸军政府公布她与红十字国际委员会官员会面的照片，系2.5年来首次确认其与外界接触；家属称“看到希望”，但信息仍由官方发布，需更多独立核验。
- [加沙停火协议蒙阴影](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/palestine-weekly-israel-kills-dozens-in-gaza-after-hamas-disarmament-deal?traffic_source=rss)：美国斡旋的哈马斯解除武装协议被宣传为突破，但此后以色列空袭反而加剧，致数十人死亡；以方“和平委员会”又称不解除武装不撤军，协议落实难言乐观。
- [俄乌冲突殃及平民](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr7kmnyrdn7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：俄方称乌克兰无人机袭击黑海海滩，致7死40伤，含3名儿童。事件凸显战争对平民的持续伤害，也给任何降温预期增添变数。
- [欧洲干旱冲击航道与电力](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78gn8zvrx4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：莱茵河等多条河流水位创纪录新低，货运减载、水电减产，能源供应链承压。气候问题已直接转化为经济瓶颈。
- [美日联手护日元](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/nx-s1-5917867/u-s-steps-in-to-help-shore-up-japanese-yen)：美日领导人确认已介入市场支撑日元，美元走弱。美国罕见直接参与干预他国汇率，折射日元贬值带来的政治经济压力。
- [法国野火引爆二战遗留炮弹](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgmkxjrrwdvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：勒波尔日村野火中传出爆炸声，疑为百枚二战弹药被引燃。极端天气叠加历史遗留危险物，给灾后安全带来新挑战。
- [知乎社区动态遭博彩刷屏](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE9va0xrVWNQckNnVUxVQXQ5bnB4VDVnZ2djNmkwcHRwam9kS1ZxNzZfOHZra2NfT0VJdW5NN0cwZ0t6dU5kUm5JX0tGVzVranl6eVE)：多篇以“鸿蒙6福利”“知乎严选年卡”为饵的文章实为博彩平台导流，已占据该子专栏。平台内容治理失守值得警惕。

后续观察：接下来关注加沙协议执行、俄方回应、欧洲干旱应急，以及知乎是否清理垃圾内容。社会新闻的“温度”藏在细节中，但暴力与气候的阴影仍在放大。
society.en:
Over the past 24 hours, the news cycle is defined by violent contradiction and environmental strain: a 'breakthrough' Gaza disarmament deal has not stopped Israeli strikes, a Russian beach resort is mourning children after a drone attack, Europe is scrambling over migration and drought, and Northeast Asia is juggling territorial disputes with record-high mutual favorability. The official Chinese desk remains dominated by state and campus media, while the Zhihu community feed has been colonized by gambling spam masquerading as platform news.

- **Gaza disintegrates despite the deal**: Israeli strikes killed dozens of Palestinians in the days after the Hamas-disarmament agreement, and the Board of Peace says there will be no Israeli withdrawal before disarmament. The diplomatic 'breakthrough' is visibly fraying. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/palestine-weekly-israel-kills-dozens-in-gaza-after-hamas-disarmament-deal?traffic_source=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/board-of-peace-says-no-israeli-withdrawal-from-gaza-before-hamas-disarms?traffic_source=rss))
- **Civilian toll in the Black Sea**: Russian officials say a Ukrainian drone killed seven people, including three children, and wounded 40 at a busy beach resort; the claims could not be independently verified and represent a sharp escalation in civilian exposure. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr7kmnyrdn7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Myanmar opens a crack**: Aung San Suu Kyi appeared in newly released photos with an ICRC official, her first confirmed external contact in 2.5 years; her son says it gives him reason to hope. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1e1d5j6660o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/nx-s1-5917915/aung-san-suu-kyi-myanmar-rare-photos-kim-aris))
- **Europe's borders and rivers are under pressure**: After the Ceuta migrant crossings, EU chief von der Leyen called for stronger borders and an urgent interior ministers meeting; drought has also dropped the Rhine to a record low, hurting freight and power output, while wildfires in France exposed WW2 shells in a village. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cyvl84zmgyro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78gn8zvrx4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgmkxjrrwdvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Asia's paradox**: South Korea formally protested Japan's Dokdo claim at the same moment polling hit a record 54.3% favorable view of Japan; North Korea threatened a new level of deterrence over Seoul's RIMPAC role. ([Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE84cHJEUldfaE5zTXlDMnBUWkRWM2JEMURUclRyNkZHOFEzbXBzeVhnNkJNWDVWazQ0dklFNEdQQnBhdXEtTUNGWGZwa1hZUEpMQUVJNDFzMHo1Zw), [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNNmtsT2t5Y1RuYWNSWHdyby1sWW16R3N1a01xZWJPLUZONHJuaGQzYVozZmpSQ2luLXZ0S0F0U0NPM19ieURFbGc2dUxtQWo0d3pZQU1jR3N4MVZoSWU5bHRaMDNVYTlTZ2MtRzF5R0x6Z2Nnal9mSDRnbnh1LWJySDJOZUJBMmFWb1N4RUt1djF4aXJMVWhxc3V0aDV0RVprZXZqemwxbw), [Aju Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5tQm54cWEySGd6WndWcTF1bHAxQkhjbjk5Z1JsWC1fdklqSElHRE1oSGVjeHdCWUZWcnVqUjJKcC02d1lDSGFXdDRhbUVRaDhkUHRwYXJFNNIBV0FVX3lxTE5tQm54cWEySGd6WndWcTF1bHAxQkhjbjk5Z1JsWC1fdklqSElHRE1oSGVjeHdCWUZWcnVqUjJKcC02d1lDSGFXdDRhbUVRaDhkUHRwYXJFNA))
- **Zhihu feed is being weaponized**: The 'community dynamics' feed is flooded with near-identical TGBUS posts promoting gambling platforms through fake 'HarmonyOS 6 welfare' and 'Zhihu Select annual card free' lures, alongside one actual board-meeting notice and a tech/AI roundup. ([TGBUS example](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE9va0xrVWNQckNnVUxVQXQ5bnB4VDVnZ2djNmkwcHRwam9kS1ZxNzZfOHZra2NfT0VJdW5NN0cwZ0t6dU5kUm5JX0tGVzVranl6eVE), [Futu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1leGtoQ1RBZ3ZOZjVJQ2d3U3YtMGwtRUd5SVY0TjFnM1NEUmNydEktYnZoOGVyajZGYkxfdW1uRkNpOUg0bEZBTlhNbHgxaFlndklNM3NubHp6VHdiMDNDNS01eXJrRjRRUFUxYVlLcWw0RHF5YnJSTk1n))

**Watch next**: Whether the U.S.-Japan currency intervention stabilizes the yen or triggers more volatility ([NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/08/03/nx-s1-5917867/u-s-steps-in-to-help-shore-up-japanese-yen)); whether the EU emergency meeting on Ceuta yields enforceable border measures; and whether North Korea matches its 'new deterrence' threat with a visible military test.

military.zh:
**导语**：过去24小时，全球军事动态呈现三条主线：美军航母部署进入南海-印度洋联动阶段，黄岩岛与斯卡伯勒浅滩（黄岩岛）再度成为中美菲博弈的焦点；伊朗与乌克兰之间的冲突外溢信号虽出现戏剧性转折，但霍尔木兹海峡与红海的航运风险仍在抬升；大国海军装备与技术竞赛同步加速，美军弗吉尼亚级潜艇重新分类、B-52升级超支等事件，折射出“大国竞争”背景下传统军备体系的深层张力。

- **美军航母罕见访越，双航母封锁阿拉伯海**：据[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/where-are-the-aircraft-carriers-august-3-2026)报道，“乔治·华盛顿”号访问越南，系2023年以来美军航母首次访越；与此同时，两艘航母在阿拉伯海维持封锁线。结合[USNI News舰队追踪](https://news.usni.org/2026/08/03/usni-news-fleet-and-marine-tracker-aug-3-2026)数据，美军全球部署态势明显向印太和中东双轴倾斜。
- **黄岩岛/斯卡伯勒浅滩成南海热点**：据[USNI News](https://news.usni.org/2026/08/03/chinese-warships-bombers-surge-to-scarborough-shoal-for-drills)，中国向黄岩岛方向派出两栖编队和轰炸机，进行海空联合演习。菲律宾国内舆论与[观察者网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTE82NUFfRjhMZzl3V21LaTdqcUFGeUw3VTRPZWNuX1R6X0RSZE9KQjM0WC1yVjQzcjM0dW9PV3dqT1lVdjFsenREQ2drVFlHOGJGV1BYNGFXSGI2R3lyY1lURG5wY1Z6NS1iOFE)报道形成呼应：菲政府在同一天向日本示好，被解读为“反华绝非少数政客作为”。
- **伊朗取消袭击乌克兰计划，但中东局势仍高度不确定**：Anadolu Ajansı与《耶路撒冷邮报》均报道，伊朗因乌克兰在船只遇袭后“道歉”而取消对乌境内3处目标的打击计划；但[The Business Standard](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQSTBaSWFiRUJaTWM0U1VBbDRWcWpzQVF6ZlpjM3dpSVlHYkNaU09JTjRlY3BHQ3hfTDBSRVJNalRCYkRHdHJMMWR2TzNDZ0RvT2RiRk5Fd2FhdVhrMGw5VHNaVjJ1aE0zRVdHTkhrWkY1V0NvV3Q2TVJ5TnZIV3I0cGRjYW9NV2E4VmhtMGk0c2h2d29J)指出美伊谈判状态未明，霍尔木兹海峡仍有商船遇袭。
- **沙特组建红海多国防务联盟**：[Global Issues.org](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzYW5GeThZRVRJOEdQWURFYXR4UjNLSEF6ZnpRQTJPSTVUWV84TWlXNEhnWTF0YXNvVEVWRDNscC1RcE1MSXYzYW5yc09ERzZiWVRteXMtVnVNQlhKSXBR)报道，在美国-伊朗战争威胁全球航运的背景下，沙特牵头组建红海多国防御联盟。这是海湾安全架构碎片化后的一个关键重组信号。
- **美军装备升级计划遭遇预算与分类冲击**：Business Insider援引监管机构报告称，美国空军B-52升级计划超支数十亿美元；[The War Zone](https://www.twz.com/sea/stretched-virginia-class-recategorized-as-guided-missile-submarines-ssgns)报道，美国海军将加长版弗吉尼亚级Block V/VI重新归类为巡航导弹潜艇（SSGN），为俄亥俄级退役做准备。这两则新闻共同指向：美军正在“以升级代替新建”与“以现役平台改型”之间艰难平衡。
- **莱茵金属推新型护卫舰竞标北美**：据[Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-new-guided-missile-frigate-projected-for-north-american-tender/)，德国莱茵金属公布GMF 140护卫舰方案，整合美军SPY-6雷达、宙斯盾作战系统、64单元垂直发射系统，目标直指加拿大和美国下一代护卫舰竞标，跨大西洋军工合作进入新阶段。

**后续观察**：未来48小时需重点关注三个节点——伊朗是否真的全面取消对乌打击（涉俄乌战争与中东战争的外溢联动）；美军航母在南海的下一步动作（“华盛顿”号访越后是否会进入南海并与黄岩岛演习编队形成接触）；以及沙特红海联盟能否获得埃及、约旦等关键阿拉伯国家的实际兵力支持。
military.en:
Over the past 24 hours, two strategic arcs dominate the military landscape. First, the US-Iran confrontation is bleeding into the Ukraine war — Tehran claimed it canceled strikes on Ukrainian sites after a Kyiv apology for a ship attack, while a separate vessel was struck in the Strait of Hormuz and talks remain uncertain. Second, in the Indo-Pacific, China has escalated maritime pressure at Scarborough Shoal at the same time Japan’s defense white paper labeled Beijing an unprecedented strategic challenge. Beneath these flashpoints, US defense programs are being repriced and reorganized around missile warfare, undersea strike, and space-based sensing.

- Iran’s strike cancellation is a fragile off-ramp: a top military adviser says Tehran scrapped plans to hit three Ukrainian sites after Kyiv’s apology, but a ship was struck in the Strait of Hormuz and US-Iran talks are in doubt ([JPost](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFA2M1FWSDJYbFUzVEMzZkZhYW92YlFmNVo2a0UyOENZc1hnejhnZm5kU0oyUnZONEhzcVVMYjBsN0dzV1ZuUFpLMG9QMGh1OGRGOXF0a2N5SFpyVk9hN19ZQkZBOGV6cFVHVXc), [The Business Standard](https://news.google.)).
- Saudi Arabia is stepping in as a security provider: Riyadh formed a multinational Red Sea defence alliance as the US-Iran war threatens global shipping ([Global Issues](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzYW5GeThZRVRJOEdQWURFYXR4UjNLSEF6ZnpRQTJPSTVUWV84TWlXNEhnWTF0YXNvVEVWRDNscC1RcE1MSXYzYW5yc09ERzZiWVRteXMtVnVNQlhKSXBR0gFkQVVfeXFMTXV0VnlVQjg0Yjl2Tjh6eTJPa1dOUU5rRHZsLUhZT0E0UUgtWU9HZXAxaFpKUkJTeTVtMDctNzJqaHhsVnZLOUwxX2pUZ09xMXZnaTNCRmFKNlFGdWk3eEVnd21TNA)). Analysts see a power shift in Middle East security and debate whether the Iran and Ukraine wars will converge ([The Week](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5NTlJ6WE9YVHdnZjRaaGp4VU5Ma0FGeW5yZ2h1NS1IUTg0WFhta3JCb0pVNnpKRUk5TGpCbXozTEtpQnFyalBPQWpsZHp1eTNrWTlCdlV4cGFhYS1tSVpvdFQyREowVzVzZEJOSV8wRW5rMU4xVEZyaw)).
- Ukraine’s war of attrition continues: 1,623 days of conflict, with fresh Russian casualty reporting and a new Western arms-trend assessment ([Defense Express](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNajA1S1hEZFZYQk9ZOExtSlRlU20wcVVNZ3YwM19zQ3Z0QWR2djZHQzJOQlF0UTNIWEFYRjFzZWtsc09TVnVCTV9VOTdDLTBnLWRwMTg5dERLS1dmM0RFNE1KSUVfZmJ3b2RLcGRpUlZkSnZkRXMySXF0eUpDUVpRREVPTnNMTjJRc20tYTlvbU1kMkRoT3ZtMmVOcmZSMXMtcDN4SW9B), [Ukraine’s Arms Monitor](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxQcDNVb3hSUnF4ckgwd2ppcGM3eldPTlFrYmZRQlhNWnppNkk0b2dZWmV6Qkk0VzNiTWp3WUZrSC1TRjU1ZVQ2ZUlzdmUzcWpvTkRBdVI5WkpkY2doVDEyNmNkdDlXZ1V1RWoxajlLUmtJMWFZWVIxWU5IdENJazZkOVRR)). Ukraine’s Fire Point is scaling production of cruise missiles and AI-enabled drones ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/news-features/ukraines-fire-point-ceo-on-how-its-making-missiles-and-drones-to-destroy-the-russian-empire)).
- China moved forces to Scarborough Shoal over the weekend, surging an amphibious group and maritime-strike bombers for drills 120 nm off the Philippines ([USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/08/03/chinese-warships-bombers-surge-to-scarborough-shoal-for-drills)). Japan’s defense white paper simultaneously called China’s military the “unprecedented greatest strategic challenge” ([Lianhe Zaobao](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQNEI2Q01lZDRJQjgwaXRXTE1fZTFTaFIwUHZsMlJVTmhISmowQ0lZandpdkpES3hvUnMySnZkQ3hCTUMwbmJVaG5zaEVEamNpRGFUal9xT2ZWaUlLYlNYZFB3V0hkaGgyYU8yejdPVEViWUNlc0JnQkQxdXQ5aUkydjhiZFJsQQ)).
- The US Navy is converting Block V/VI Virginia-class submarines into guided-missile submarines to fill the Ohio SSGN gap ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/stretched-virginia-class-recategorized-as-guided-missile-submarines-ssgns)) and installed the first SPY-6(V)4 radar array at Wallops Island for the USS Pinckney modernization line ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/raytheon-installs-first-spy-6v4-radar-us-navy-flight-iia-destroyer/)).
- Cost and industrial capacity are pressing: the B-52 upgrade is billions over budget according to a watchdog ([Business Insider](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQLXUzUG5YQVRvSmJzdjFPLV83bldqWTU2eUJHd2VWakVGV1ZaT2NLRS1pZzZJNzBkTW1VajJ4RUF5Zkl5V3BYeUt2NVYxUVVBUXdtbU82ZTRqSG9DZml0bVJpTXlJMFk0SnVIVzlhTVhYZHB6MnJ4Q2pkcEZBNWZsZmd5bkdTSDZmMTVqeHRGYUFDYjJXU2NWUjZMREJEUFZaZ0c0)); Rheinmetall unveiled a 64-cell AEGIS frigate concept for North America ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-new-guided-missile-frigate-projected-for-north-american-tender/)); and the Space Force is moving optical laser-link tests to K2 to support Golden Dome ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/k2-tapped-to-host-space-force-satellite-laser-links-tests/)).
- At sea, two carriers are on blockade in the Arabian Sea, USS George Washington made a rare Vietnam port call, and allied navies are enforcing sanctions — Italy’s PPA Thaon di Revel boarded sanctioned shadow tanker Toa Payoh under Operation IRINI ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/where-are-the-aircraft-carriers-august-3-2026), [Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/08/italian-navy-boards-sanctioned-shadow-fleet-tanker/)).

**Watch next:** whether Tehran’s “cancelled” strikes actually hold after the Hormuz incident; whether Riyadh’s Red Sea alliance gains concrete naval commitments; and whether the PLA keeps a sustained presence at Scarborough Shoal into this week. Also track the first SPY-6(V)4 backfit and the Navy’s SSGN conversion timeline as Pentagon budget signals emerge.

tech.zh:
导语：过去24小时，科技新闻的关键词是“分层”：AI从模型竞赛滑向成本战、军事落地与商业路线分歧；EV在中国长续航/大马力攻势和特斯拉硬件老化之间展开；可穿戴数据互通、云AI私有化则让技术价值回归生态协同。

- **OpenAI与苹果公开交恶。** OpenAI发文“Apple is getting this wrong”，HN上93分/81评，主流开发者认为OpenAI没有护城河，回应更像“desperate”（[OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/apple-is-getting-this-wrong/)，[HN讨论](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49164649)）。DeepMind与OpenAI的人才战同步加剧（[Google News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMie0FVX3lxTE5iMzYydGZITW93cXZzUm81WkxWRThheTZXcFVBeTBId2U2NlN1Zml5ZmNTM0NRVW8xRlhuMHVpMmY4TXh4Rm5MczJQTkQ4RGZTOFlSNHl5aUd3MW5OekdKRGNpZDNkRVB2eENfeVpKcDRJTVhuWV9IYzZPQQ)）。
- **中美AI“性价比”叙事获得金融媒体背书。** 彭博称中国AI闪电战制造“死亡地带”，《经济学人》称中国花更少钱办更多事；Palantir CEO Karp在盈利10亿美元后称AI实验室“马克思主义”，美国商业AI内部分裂（[Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-04/china-s-ai-blitz-creates-death-zone-for-rival-us-model-makers)，[Economist](https://www.economist.com/finance-and-economics/2026/08/03/how-china-gets-better-bang-for-its-buck-than-america-in-ai)，[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/03/after-killer-quarter-palantir-ceo-alex-karp-calls-ai-industry-marxist/)）。
- **AI武器化从演示到列装。** 1亿美元合同为5万架乌克兰无人机加装AI自主跟踪能力，后续或支持蜂群攻击（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/08/ukraines-drones-get-ai-upgrades-for-kamikaze-strikes-future-swarm-attacks/)）。
- **云厂商推动AI开发“私有化+小模型化”。** AWS将Superblocks嵌入客户私有云，Cloudflare展示Kimi/GLM小模型规模运行（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/03/aws-is-helping-vibe-coding-startup-superblocks-and-the-implications-are-big/)，[Cloudflare](https://blog.cloudflare.com/smaller-faster-safer-models/)）。
- **EV：中国进攻，特斯拉承压。** Denza Z9S开订，1100km续航、低于5万美元；吉利Galaxy Battleship 700达1113马力。特斯拉FSD v14 Lite却在HW3上引发电脑过热/故障（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/08/03/byd-opens-denza-z9s-pre-orders-record-1100-km-ev-range/)，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/08/03/geely-galaxy-battleship-700-tri-motor-stuffs-1113-hp-in-a-high-luxe-boxy-package/)，[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/08/03/tesla-fsd-v14-lite-hw3-computer-failures/)）。
- **生态开放与社区反思。** Fitbit数据直连Apple Health；HN上“LLMs reward expertise”771分/326评，Bradbury旧文和C-Kermit 45周年也上热榜（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/974778/google-health-fitbit-data-apple-health-syncing)，[LLMs](https://www.seangoedecke.com/llms-reward-expertise/)，[Kermit](https://changelog.complete.org/archives/44456-celebrating-45-years-of-kermit-with-the-first-new-c-kermit-release-in-15-years-and-working-with-a-decades-old-c-codebase)）。

后续观察：AI的下半场不再只看模型性能，而是看单位成本、私有化部署和军事/企业场景控制力；特斯拉HW3故障可能迫使FSD重新界定硬件红线。千公里EV续航正从宣传走向5万美元级量产，真实工况测试将成下一个战场。
tech.en:
The last 24 hours in technology were defined by an escalating AI platform war, fresh evidence that China's AI ecosystem is squeezing U.S. model makers, and a wave of EV launches overshadowed by a Tesla reliability scare. On the consumer side, Google finally connected Fitbit to Apple Health, while Hacker News users debated whether LLMs reward expertise rather than replace it.

- OpenAI vs. Apple and strategy doubts: OpenAI published a sharp rebuttal to Apple's lawsuit, 'Apple is getting this wrong,' and Hacker News threaded 81 comments arguing OpenAI lacks a moat as models commoditize. ([OpenAI](https://openai.com/index/apple-is-getting-this-wrong/) / [HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49164649))
- Palantir's trust attack: After a $1 billion profit quarter, CEO Alex Karp called AI labs 'Marxist' and warned enterprises not to trust frontier labs — making 'trust' Palantir's wedge against OpenAI and Anthropic. ([TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/08/03/after-killer-quarter-palantir-ceo-alex-karp-calls-ai-industry-marxist/))
- China's cost pressure: The Economist says China gets better AI bang for its buck; Bloomberg says China's AI blitz is creating a 'death zone' for U.S. model makers. Price and efficiency, not frontier flash, are now the main battleground. ([Economist](https://www.economist.com/finance-and-economics/2026/08/03/how-china-gets-better-bang-for-its-buck-than-america-in-ai) / [Bloomberg](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-08-04/china-s-ai-blitz-creates-death-zone-for-rival-us-model-makers))
- Autonomous weapons: A $100 million deal puts U.S. AI in 50,000 Ukrainian kamikaze drones for autonomous target tracking — a milestone for military AI and drone swarms. ([Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/ai/2026/08/ukraines-drones-get-ai-upgrades-for-kamikaze-strikes-future-swarm-attacks/))
- Fitbit finally talks to Apple Health: Google Health's 5.05 update lets Fitbit steps, workouts, and vitals sync directly into Apple Health, ending a major walled-garden gap. ([The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/974778/google-health-fitbit-data-apple-health-syncing))
- EV reliability vs. Chinese spectacle: Tesla owners report FSD v14 Lite is overheating HW3 computers, while BYD opened pre-orders for the Denza Z9S with a claimed 1,100 km range and Geely announced the 1,113 hp Galaxy 700. The contrast is striking. ([Electrek HW3](https://electrek.co/2026/08/03/tesla-fsd-v14-lite-hw3-computer-failures/) / [Electrek Denza](https://electrek.co/2026/08/03/byd-opens-denza-z9s-pre-orders-record-1100-km-ev-range/) / [Electrek Geely](https://electrek.co/2026/08/03/geely-galaxy-battleship-700-tri-motor-stuffs-1113-hp-in-a-high-luxe-boxy-package/))
- Hacker News's big idea: 'LLMs reward expertise' drew 771 points and 326 comments, arguing AI tools make experts more productive rather than replacing them — a counterweight to AI panic. ([HN](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49161518))

Watch next: Watch for Tesla's response to HW3 failures, whether Palantir's trust messaging gains enterprise traction, and if Denza Z9S pre-orders confirm China's range leadership is now a commercial weapon.

sports.zh:
过去24小时，体育世界进入“赛季切换”节奏：英超尚未开球就刷新换帅纪录，欧洲转会窗持续发酵；篮球线则出现CBA旧将转型NBA教练、中国小将留洋西班牙等结构信号。与此同时，UFC选手去世、F1赛历应急预案等消息提示，赛场之外的风险依然不可忽视。今日板块提纯如下：

- [英超新赛季“未赛先火”](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cddjmd6189yo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：2026-27赛季尚未开战，经理更替数量已创历史纪录；BBC还从20家英超俱乐部各选一位新星，显示各家在换帅动荡中把青训当作稳定器。
- [转会窗传闻](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cy5dqynxdezo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：Fenerbahce准备为拉什福德开出“破纪录”级别报价；RB Leipzig在扬·迪奥曼德转会皇马一事上拒绝松口；阿森纳接触布鲁诺·吉马良斯。中锋与后腰市场可能因此重新定价。
- [虎扑社区焦点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE8xNFVJdExJNzJMQk4tLVo2cW5ycktjVEVkd0JYa05lWjdtUFI0RDU3dVVGVndyTHVpcmtGT2FfdnZDeTA0V1MxbXlXeGlzbGNOM3V6M2t5UQ)：博主曝姆巴佩希望与贝林厄姆缓和关系，但后者不愿先迈步；切尔西被指目前引援投入最大、维尔贝克加盟并有多人离队。两条帖子的共同点是转会传闻与更衣室政治深度绑定。
- [凯尔特人卫冕起步](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cpd72xwyjw9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：蒂尔尼回归首秀即证明价值，帮助球队击败邓迪；瑞典前锋贝里斯特伦从三明治工改行、骑车参加欧冠比赛的经历，则给附加赛增添了一个励志注脚。[链接](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyq7kgx9dko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- [UFC悲剧获交叉证实](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/mixed-martial-arts/articles/cvgwvnje09po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：巴西选手阿兰·纳西门托34岁猝然离世，UFC官方确认，BBC与Sky互相印证。MMA社区的疲劳管理与健康风险再次成为讨论点。[Sky链接](https://www.skysports.com/mma/news/12040/13569592/allan-nascimento-ufc-fighter-dies-aged-34-after-suffering-apparent-heart-attack-in-his-sleep)
- [跨项动态](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13569381/f1-2027-calendar-contingency-plans-in-place-for-next-years-formula-1-schedule-amid-us-israel-war-with-iran)：F1确认2027赛历已有应急预案，以应对中东冲突持续；拉杜卡努因应力性骨折缺席美网；诺里在加拿大公开赛直落两盘晋级；劳拉·戴维斯呼吁查莉·赫尔在索尔海姆杯承担领袖角色。[拉杜卡努](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cn4njxg33l7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) [诺里](https://www.skysports.com/watch/video/13569589/camilo-ugo-carabelli-vs-cam-norrie-canadian-open-highlights) [索尔海姆杯](https://www.skysports.com/golf/news/12040/13569570/solheim-cup-2026-charley-hull-must-step-up-and-lead-team-europe-in-netherlands-says-dame-laura-davies)
- [板球人物](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/cgljg1ezyr9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：斯托克斯表示未来愿执教英格兰队，同时担心乔·鲁特长期兼任队长的消耗。围绕“队长负荷”的讨论在英媒升温。

后续观察：英超开赛前换帅潮可能进一步影响转会策略；中东局势若在2027年仍未缓和，F1不得不调整海外场次；UFC悲剧和篮球留洋案例，将把运动员健康与职业生涯转型推向更高优先级。另，今日原始信息流中混入多条博彩/应用推广内容，已作剔除。
sports.en:
The last 24 hours in sports were shaped by a volatile build-up to the European season, a transfer market ready to disrupt major clubs, and a Chinese sports feed that mixed real roster moves with heavy app-promo noise. The useful signal is in Premier League managerial churn, Kieran Tierney's early impact, and two basketball development stories.

- Record managerial churn: The 2026-27 Premier League has already set a record for pre-season manager changes. New coaches bring tactical uncertainty, and BBC's [one prospect to watch at every club](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cre4np3pnxqo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) suggests the early table could be hard to call. See [record number of new managers](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cddjmd6189yo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss).
- Transfer market heating up: Fenerbahce are preparing a huge offer for Marcus Rashford, Arsenal have opened talks over Bruno Guimaraes, and RB Leipzig are holding firm against Real Madrid for Yan Diomande. A Rashford exit would force Manchester United into a late replacement scramble. [BBC transfer gossip](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cy5dqynxdezo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Celtic's title defence starts well: Kieran Tierney was immediately influential in Celtic's Scottish Premiership win over Dundee, giving the champions a defensive anchor for the season. [Tierney analysis](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cpd72xwyjw9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Football culture and history: Mjallby striker Jacob Bergstrom, a former sandwich maker who cycles to games, is one Champions League qualifier away from upsetting Yaya Toure's new club. Separately, key figures revisited how Euro 2016 changed Welsh football a decade on. [Bergstrom](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/clyq7kgx9dko?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [Welsh football](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/ced4lq94ldvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Non-football wires: F1 has contingency plans for the 2027 calendar amid Middle East conflict; Emma Raducanu will miss the US Open; UFC fighter Allan Nascimento died at 34; Ben Stokes wants to coach England in future. [F1](https://www.skysports.com/f1/news/12040/13569381/f1-2027-calendar-contingency-plans-in-place-for-next-years-formula-1-schedule-amid-us-israel-war-with-iran) / [Raducanu](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/tennis/articles/cn4njxg33l7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [Nascimento](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/mixed-martial-arts/articles/cvgwvnje09po?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) / [Stokes](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/cgljg1ezyr9o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)
- Basketball development: Will Barton is joining the Timberwolves as player development coach, and Chinese media argue Wu Jiahao's Spanish Liga ACB move is a smarter long-term path than the U.S. because of American basketball's high elimination rate. [Barton](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTFAwWnVKOWlNdC1ycUV5SUszSlI1MUtSMDktemhHdDJ2enZxZnRKV2VQQTJoNG5nOXI1MVU2WDVGVnJQLXlwTU00MS1naHFWUDJFNWdsOHlrWTM4X2ZnUTFPOElzODhYODBTU1B2bFREWQ) / [Wu Jiahao](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihAFBVV95cUxPRGxRbjE3U0cxaXdiTWgyWjBMX09ZQU1Uek1JOUlwV3NrTDZuSHp0ODhIeTZwWVpZZWF0NHpmWGttUjhtcTU0SDBnaW5MUDdsYmpPRGNEVUJDdjZKb2RvU2Y2VndXcko2V1dDOW1KaGJnQmJPdDRPWjlINHFSOUtUZlBnaWU)
- Hupu fan signals: Mbappe-Bellingham tension, Alex Eala's title run, Trey Murphy III's camp and a LeBron GOAT quote drove forum discussion. [Mbappe](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE8xNFVJdExJNzJMQk4tLVo2cW5ycktjVEVkd0JYa05lWjdtUFI0RDU3dVVGVndyTHVpcmtGT2FfdnZDeTA0V1MxbXlXeGlzbGNOM3V6M2t5UQ) / [Eala](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE92clFEWlcwUEdCQkstR25wV2VZTlVuT0pfZEhoZjB5d3NtaUtCMVU1ZDN4Skh0cnd1U25oQjd0T2lKTTVwRlg1RkszR3ZjMkNGLVFoR0x3) / [Murphy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTFB1VE1HTzI4aVQtc2JEZEd3WEJ1SFUwN3VEMXQ1ZFR3Z05xeXM2VzlrdWxMTHpLLUc1SkM4Mm12dUd2NUFsTTZhNnNUc2tHaGQ4S3l4LXJB) / [LeBron](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVkFVX3lxTE9wa25tOGp4eElSb0NQNmlibU9vSjJnT21xMF9ReWpxeFdxSlg3NklJdldhZGtpS04xUldHTFF2LUx5VmdwcWtFYmlnbm9RRTBlT3hTVjZR)
- Noise warning: A large portion of Chinese-sourced basketball and Hupu items were TGBUS app promos dressed as upgrades and data reports; they should be treated as advertising, not editorial. [Example TGBUS promo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXEFVX3lxTE42b29PdjBtczd1UEQwUzRxT1dXT1dfdzFqYUI4UTRlQlVjLVRwdi16NVlSTWxMVTZ4UU5YM2lnUjNYdjllMllpMEplTFJQSnJvelVVbTJCWXcyLUxQ)

Watch next: The next 48 hours will turn on whether Fenerbahce formalise their Rashford bid and whether Madrid's camp addresses the Mbappe-Bellingham talk. In China, Wu Jiahao's signing announcement and Hupu's moderation of sponsored posts will determine how much clean signal the desk produces.

entertainment.zh:
过去24小时，娱乐信息流的关键词是“官宣”与“边界”：韩国剧集扎堆定档九月，Ariana Grande在芝加哥回应“暂别”，微博热搜则被旧照搬运与偶遇话题占据。以下是编辑取舍。

- 韩剧秋季档提前开跑。[《The Ordinary Jackpot》确认9月10日首播](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859842wpp/lee-jun-hyuks-new-drama-the-ordinary-jackpot-confirms-september-premiere-date)，李浚赫回归办公室题材；更大变量是[《Made in Korea》第二季定档9月9日](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/hyun-bin-jung-woosung-made-in-korea-season-2-1236827347/)，玄彬、郑雨盛、禹棹焕回归，Variety与Soompi预告相互印证，显示韩流大制作正同时押注本土与北美流媒体。
- Ariana Grande把“暂别”改写为主动边界声明。她在芝加哥United Center说这不是“reactive or impulsive”，而是“boundaries need to be set”（[滚石现场报道](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/ariana-grande-break-public-eye-pauses-show-speaks-to-fans-1235603155/)）。BBC、THR、Deadline等信源交叉报道，说明团队用现场发言校准舆论。
- 韩剧收视出现积极信号：[tvN《My Bias, My Boss》首播全国收视4.2%](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859725wpp/my-bias-my-boss-premieres-to-a-promising-start)；K-pop女团战升温，[aespa发布《Switchblade》MV](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859794wpp/watch-aespa-and-ty-dolla-ign-show-how-they-switch-it-up-in-bold-mv-for-b-side-switchblade)，[Red Velvet《Surfin' Boy》拿下15区iTunes冠军](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE9UYjFqNDhhOFdNN19iMENXY1Rodld6c3ktX29ZaGxvb3NvMTZobkpvcVVRcUNlYmRna18yZWpaZzhjZDA0SlYzZUw1Yzh3bV9XSlNGVWxVWHNDS2s)。
- 线下产业侧，[ChinaJoy现场人气](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5faTZNNkt2UGJDeVpmaGdEUjlfQUFBcU5fUkxwdnU5Z0x5a3NqcFVnWHFfMHpqdTJvSVU4ZTdiSGxRTlFNMGdMVjZmWTJzb1lwRXlKaFhzSl9aNkplVUZueU9ZYVNvTTJYRTI0NExBc3Y3dUdQNHFQWA)成为文娱回暖注脚，人体工学新品也进入展会（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFA0dGJ4bWQ3b01vZWJkcUNIQm15ZEw2X2Q0YVZUVGZNWHdSbUppRkFiS0dLOElBVHBGWUN5ME9qSWZDT2cxQk5LNDJOVFBCQTBtdEcteUJiUHdITkpZa3VxZ3htQU5TQ2FTQWxLNUs2QWJ5SzNJdmJVelJPcFU)）；中韩产业连接同步加速，[KMG与中国FEDORA娱乐合作推动尹施允、李水京出海](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1kMTJGNjhoUzZMU3FBZnNvb3RLRVZmT3V0NE9DajJyNl96NlB2aWhyNXVaZm9xajdicjYxQ2VzZTh3MUF6UVREdHhhSm9UeDVaX0hKZFFaV0dGUzA)。
- 微博端，[张凌赫与母亲旧照被搬运引爆“素人隐私”讨论](https://news.google.)，[王一博新西兰偶遇](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFBJWnlnSFJyR2hOSnNEWU9fcElpVUt6cjRRd1BiTWFjWjlCOHc1SWV6SzJFSGFzdF9iRHkwQVE5Mk80UHRteGtxdUItT1JrSFQ4WVJlWWZYQ0JoTVFWOFlabzJBWk1Va3ZsbGVGVVF4bUM)、[刘耀文演唱会落泪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE93Q3ZuUzFHR2ZTUVJBS2RiaENxM1VzWkxUMTdiNk9xU05JOXdUQU5jS3pkY3VLbDZWMm5SbGEtWFd2RU1JMVdZMjZfcHBHMEVaN1lWQVdfZkR4VTVQcDJiSmtOcEZlZUZ5aTgyRVMxRmk)等热搜则延续粉丝情绪流量。

**后续观察：**九月初是韩剧与流媒体的密集档期，《Made in Korea》第二季能否延续热度，将决定“韩国原创剧”的下一个爆款叙事；Ariana Grande的“暂别”也为艺人巡演末段的公关提供范本——与其被传唤，不如主动设界。
entertainment.en:
Entertainment coverage over the past 24 hours ran on two tracks: the business of attention—streaming dates, festival sales, chart performance—and the emotional labor of celebrity, from Ariana Grande's carefully explained break to Weibo debates about fan conduct and privacy. The strongest strategic signal is the September cluster of Korean originals: Disney+ has scheduled “Made in Korea 2” for Sept. 9 and TVING's “The Ordinary Jackpot” for Sept. 10, putting two high-profile dramas in direct competition for the same global audience.

- The Korean pipeline is entering a concentrated release window. Disney+ confirmed the six-episode second season of “Made in Korea” will stream from Sept. 9 with Hyun Bin, Jung Woo-sung, and Woo Do-hwan returning ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/hyun-bin-jung-woosung-made-in-korea-season-2-1236827347/), [Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859744wpp/watch-made-in-korea-2-announces-premiere-date-with-new-teaser)). TVING's office drama “The Ordinary Jackpot,” starring Lee Jun-hyuk, follows on Sept. 10 ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859842wpp/lee-jun-hyuks-new-drama-the-ordinary-jackpot-confirms-september-premiere-date)).
- Early ratings give the current Korean broadcast slate a healthy pulse: tvN's webtoon adaptation “My Bias, My Boss” opened at 4.2 percent nationwide on Aug. 3 ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859725wpp/my-bias-my-boss-premieres-to-a-promising-start)). Casting also stayed hot, with “Flex X Cop 2” confirming Yoo Seung-ho as a special villain ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1859824wpp/flex-x-cop-2-director-dishes-on-casting-yoo-seung-ho-as-the-dramas-new-villain)).
- Ariana Grande's planned step back from visibility dominated Western coverage. She paused her Chicago show to tell fans the decision was “not a reactive or impulsive thing” and that “boundaries... need to be set” ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/ariana-grande-break-public-eye-pauses-show-speaks-to-fans-1235603155/), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c6295z6jkw6o), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/08/ariana-grande-upcoming-break-boundaries-1237016875/)). The Hollywood Reporter frames it as a direct response to Sunday's announcement that she will step back after the Eternal Sunshine Tour ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-news/ariana-grande-clarifies-why-step-back-public-eye-after-tour-1236663495/)).
- The Locarno film market is providing early sales momentum. Shudder took U.S. rights to horror “Bloody Tennis,” with additional deals across Europe, Japan, Australia, Italy, Poland, and the Baltics ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/global/bloody-tennis-shudder-major-territories-sales-locarno-1236826572/)); “All the Lovers in the Night,” starring Tadanobu Asano and Yukino Kishii, landed North American distribution ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/tadanobu-asano-all-the-lovers-in-the-night-north-america-sales-1236827351/)).
- The industry also processed losses and accountability stories: British comedian Jimmy Cricket died at 80 ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c70g94zr1zgo)), “Spider-Man: No Way Home” actress Mary Egida Rivera died at 82 ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/08/mary-egida-rivera-dead-spider-man-no-way-home-actress-1236980295/)), and ex-BBC anchor Huw Edwards was criticized for entering a poetry competition ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cm2ge428md0o)).
- China's entertainment ecosystem is expanding through infrastructure and cross-border deals: the China International Digital Interactive Entertainment Exhibition drew crowds and product launches ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTFA0dGJ4bWQ3b01vZWJkcUNIQm15ZEw2X2Q0YVZUVGZNWHdSbUppRkFiS0dLOElBVHBGWUN5ME9qSWZDT2cxQk5LNDJOVFBCQTBtdEcteUJiUHdITkpZa3VxZ3htQU5TQ2FTQWxLNUs2QWJ5SzNJdmJVelJPcFU)), while KMG and China's FEDORA Entertainment formalized a talent-market partnership ([Asia Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1kMTJGNjhoUzZMU3FBZnNvb3RLRVZmT3V0NE9DajJyNl96NlB2aWhyNXVaZm9xajdicjYxQ2VzZTh3MUF6UVREdHhhSm9UeDVaX0hKZFFaV0dGUzA)). Weibo, meanwhile, turned celebrity sightings into privacy debates and even pushed U.S. sanctions on Chinese consumer brands into entertainment feeds ([WenxueCity](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE93VDMxbXd2WHZEQmpBTnZwWENtTkxGcVNoVmhsVXg0WW9JbkFhdGYxaFd5aGh4ODByR3NfbnoxQk5JdF9MV1lEbzQ5enUxN29tVmhwOG5wUlpRWWlaTE5NeTBCSHZrVkJF)).

Watch next: whether Sept. 9–10 becomes a zero-sum clash for Korean streaming originals, whether Ariana's clarification defuses fan anxiety, and whether ChinaJoy deal flow produces concrete production announcements in the coming weeks.

美股.zh:
概览：美股在伊朗局势升级与财报季正面对撞中震荡，油价与汇率成为核心矛盾。美联储监管新规、关税诉讼等政策线索亦在发酵。

- 特朗普将美伊谈判定义为“最后机会”，伊朗否认令油价再度上行压力，BP、沙特阿美财报暴增，但白宫对化石燃料行业的敌意加深。[特朗普](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/us-iran-war-trump-hormuz.html)[BP](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/bp-2q-earnings-oil-iran-war.html)[沙特](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/saudi-aramco-earnings-2q-oil-iran-war.html)
- 美国通过出售欧元干预日元汇率，绕开美债市场敏感区，美元与日元利差交易面临重塑。[CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/cnbc-daily-open-yen-intervention-dollar-euro-fx.html)[NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/03/business/us-japan-yen-intervention.html)
- 汇丰第二季度税前利润超预期，净利息收入与费用增长强劲，并重启10亿美元回购；Grab在AI优化下上调全年预期。[汇丰](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/hsbc-profit-beats-estimates-higher-net-interest-income-fees.html)[Grab](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/grab-earnings-ai-forecast-cfo-.html)
- 美国多州起诉特朗普政府对60国加征关税，称其超越权限，贸易政策不确定性拖累跨国企业盈利预期。[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cy4kp8jd0ppo)

收束：短期焦点仍在伊朗与汇率，若地缘风险降温，美股可能迎来业绩与估值修复，但关税诉讼和AI抛售余波不容忽视。
美股.en:
US equity desks are torn between blowout oil-major earnings and a sudden flaring of Middle East headlines, with an unusual FX intervention story adding another layer. The prior session's sharp oil drop lifted risk sentiment, but Tuesday's 'last chance' warning shows how quickly the narrative can reverse.

- BP's second-quarter profit more than doubled, and Saudi Aramco's profit rose 33%, as the Iran war squeezed supply and lifted prices; Trump's attacks on Big Oil add political risk to energy-sector valuations. [CNBC BP](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/bp-2q-earnings-oil-iran-war.html), [CNBC Aramco](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/saudi-aramco-earnings-2q-oil-iran-war.html)
- Trump says the latest Iran negotiations are the 'last chance' to avoid escalation, while Tehran denies talks; crude oil firmed on the uncertainty. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/us-iran-war-trump-hormuz.html), [CNBC Trump insists](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/03/trump-iran-us-negotiations-peace-proposals-.html)
- Reports say Washington sold euros to fund its yen intervention, avoiding the sensitive US Treasury market; the NYT frames this as a broader warning about Japanese market turmoil. [CNBC Daily Open](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/cnbc-daily-open-yen-intervention-dollar-euro-fx.html), [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/08/03/business/us-japan-yen-intervention.html)
- HSBC beat pretax profit estimates on higher net interest income and fees, then earmarked $1bn for buybacks, a signal from a major global lender. [CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/08/04/hsbc-profit-beats-estimates-higher-net-interest-income-fees.html), [SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362872/hsbc-sets-aside-us1-billion-first-share-buy-back-october)
- The Federal Reserve requested comment on modernising rules for bank insider lending and mutual banking organisations, a slow-burn regulatory story for regional banks. [Fed insider-lending](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731b.htm), [Fed mutual banks](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260731a.htm)

Signal to watch: whether oil's geopolitical risk premium holds or fades - that will decide if energy stocks keep outperforming or if rate-sensitive growth takes over.

欧洲经济.zh:
概览：地缘政治退烧给欧洲市场带来喘息，但经济内部结构性问题与潜在通胀风险依旧纠缠。央行话题和产业并购成为焦点。

- 特朗普取消对伊打击后，布伦特原油跌至83美元附近，欧洲股市与政府债券同步走强，风险偏好回暖。[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/oil-prices-fall-europe-stock-markets-donald-trump-iran-us-brent-crude)
- 欧洲央行研究显示，伊朗战争对欧元区消费的打击超过其他地区；同时，ECB工资追踪器显示Q1协商工资增速稳定在2.7%，服务通胀压力有所缓解。[Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPSEhIQmRnRGRhT3FNNFBJcWdIeFd4THBVYnMtM3d6ODFUZnBWcU9VVVlKdjNBNTlhbWpYX0dBTXNQb2JOTmdNT0NSQ2NaMkVzWjJSVk9EV3RWajB1U05YZURnSWpvbjJNdy1QTVNad2tFbnloaVEzejZUM2NsU19PUTMzNFJZMk5udkViUkxXeGRJdGp2NG1lQVd3dGxEa004VkVsTWJaVQ)[ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html)
- 7月PMI显示德国驱动欧洲工厂活动反弹，制造业回暖迹象初现；但英国市场更担心天然气价格而非原油的二次通胀效应。[PMI](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE9pLWJtUC1Pb0hxaWxWd01MM3FLN0FiQTV6ZmE4Tkw5aWhqa0FHUk1HQzFmaEpMRGZJX3BNM1ZSb0ZVTzVvTUtYQ3pUM0hpQ3JC)[天然气](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPV0ZEdzc1bmFiT2ZHdWxzVEQ4VUUtV2NmVDRTQmtfa1A1bWZQNWdTTHozZjg3NS1BZFJQMDJTZUVJNnNEMjdsSzl5bURtdEdFZzZOSkNjN2VpUGtLc2JiWTVrZ0tSLTdCelh1TEh6aDZ1R1pkaDd4ZDFKd2RZdVhNa2pVSFNmNm55X3J4bDhZdmNJZHUyelFlWjMxNEk3MU1jbW82NUFmYw)
- 阿斯利康洽购百时美施贵宝，估值近4000亿美元，若成功将诞生全球第四大药企，但市场质疑并购逻辑，阿斯利康市值蒸发逾170亿英镑。[Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/astrazeneca-talks-bristol-myers-squibb-merger-pharmaceuticals)

收束：欧洲资产的反弹仍系于美国中东政策的外溢，缺乏内生需求支撑的上涨难以持续，关注下周PMI终值和ECB官员表态。
欧洲经济.en:
European markets rallied sharply when Trump called off Iran strikes, but the relief was short-lived as the geopolitical clock reset and the ECB detailed how much the war is hurting euro zone consumers. The data mix points to a fragile, Germany-led recovery.

- Brent crude plunged 5% to $83.47 on Monday, lifting European stocks and government bonds; the move marks a rapid repricing of conflict risk. [Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/oil-prices-fall-europe-stock-markets-donald-trump-iran-us-brent-crude)
- ECB research says the Iran war hit euro area consumption especially hard, reinforcing concerns that energy inflation is suppressing household spending more than in other regions. [Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPSEhIQmRnRGRhT3FNNFBJcWdIeFd4THBVYnMtM3d6ODFUZnBWcU9VVVlKdjNBNTlhbWpYX0dBTXNQb2JOTmdNT0NSQ2NaMkVzWjJSVk9EV3RWajB1U05YZURnSWpvbjJNdy1QTVNad2tFbnloaVEzejZUM2NsU19PUTMzNFJZMk5udkViUkxXeGRJdGp2NG1lQVd3dGxEa004VkVsTWJaVQ)
- The ECB's wage tracker came in at 2.7% in Q1 2027, indicating stable negotiated wage pressure, while the ECB also committed to high accessibility standards for the digital euro app. [ECB wage tracker](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html), [ECB digital euro](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260730~3b3bfbb565.en.html)
- July PMIs show Germany driving a European factory rebound, an encouraging sign after months of industrial weakness. [Trans.INFO](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUEFVX3lxTE9pLWJtUC1Pb0hxaWxWd01MM3FLN0FiQTV6ZmE4Tkw5aWhqa0FHUk1HQzFmaEpMRGZJX3BNM1ZSb0ZVTzVvTUtYQ3pUM0hpQ3JC)
- The UK's inflation risk is more about natural gas prices than oil, and AstraZeneca fell to the UK's third-largest company after Bristol Myers Squibb merger talks wiped out £17bn in market value. [Market Minute](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxPV0ZEdzc1bmFiT2ZHdWxzVEQ4VUUtV2NmVDRTQmtfa1A1bWZQNWdTTHozZjg3NS1BZFJQMDJTZUVJNnNEMjdsSzl5bURtdEdFZzZOSkNjN2VpUGtLc2JiWTVrZ0tSLTdCelh1TEh6aDZ1R1pkaDd4ZDFKd2RZdVhNa2pVSFNmNm55X3J4bDhZdmNJZHUyelFlWjMxNEk3MU1jbW82NUFmYw), [Guardian AstraZeneca](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/aug/03/astrazeneca-talks-bristol-myers-squibb-merger-pharmaceuticals)

Signal to watch: the euro area's consumption channel remains the weak link; any deterioration in natural gas supplies or a return to Iran escalation would hit European equities and rate expectations hardest.

中国经济.zh:
概览：A股在经历全球AI抛售后的去杠杆阵痛后，8月4日迎来强劲反弹，同时中港金融互联互通再提速，政策底与市场底或正在接近。

- 创业板指8月4日收涨5.64%，算力硬件、元件、CPO等AI算力产业链全线爆发，显示资金重新回流科技成长板块。[收评](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ycVNUWm5wOTV0WFhIeWU2M2VqQ2hvVHc3bENBdFQzQ203TmxLelJucFFiejBTRmk1cC1iNG1ydVZDdXVfZXU3YngxUVpfZXhwdG95Nm5EMFVfVkNFd3c)
- 7月两融余额降至2.59万亿元，较峰值减少14%，但中信证券等主流券商认为A股仅为调整而非趋势反转，8月有望在产业景气支撑下修复。[杠杆](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362797/china-stock-traders-cut-leveraged-positions-14-july-amid-tech-sell)[券商](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362812/why-chinese-brokers-forecast-share-tech-and-chip-rebound)
- 中港市场深化联手：官方宣布更多互联互通措施，港交所推出五年期中国国债期货，进一步便利境外资金参与人民币资产配置。[措施](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNRU5PSVQ3amNQS0VnQ2VSOEZaX2pWZGJfcjFHbUJBRFN6ejc4YmlpUGhwdkFtMUxVWm03U3U4LTY2UG9uMTlxd05pZ0pnRDVQYkEtQ0FKeWRwS056cW1sb2FOWmtvVTN0NnJNQ05US0dWSEx4djdVaW1abjdydlNVMDJDeHo3cDFKMjJzMlB4QUpNckVsUnYzVURyc25zUQ)[国债期货](https://news.google.)
- 基本面亮点与分化共存：药明康德上半年净利同比增33.7%至110.8亿元，受益于减肥药与糖尿病药物需求；但蔚来、小鹏、理想7月交付量环比下降，价格战阴云再起。[药明](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362817/chinese-biotech-giant-wuxi-apptec-sees-first-half-earnings-surge-amid-us-scrutiny)[EV](https://www.scmp.com/plus/business/china-evs/article/3362799/chinese-ev-sales-falter-home-growth-slows)
- 汇丰继三个季度暂停后重启10亿美元回购，凸显对香港及内地市场的信心；跨国公司如可口可乐、联合利华在华销售强劲，与本土消费疲弱形成反差。[汇丰](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362872/hsbc-sets-aside-us1-billion-first-share-buy-back-october)[消费](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362787/multinational-giants-defy-chinas-sluggish-retail-market-strong-2026-sales)

收束：市场正试图在“AI去杠杆”与“政策催化”之间寻找平衡，后续关注MLF操作和科技巨头中期业绩对情绪的影响。
中国经济.en:
China desks saw a violent sentiment swing: Monday's AI-led selloff in Chinese tech and chip names was followed by a huge A-share rebound on Tuesday, aided by broker calls that the mainland pullback was only a correction, not a leverage-driven crash. Policymakers also pushed ahead with Hong Kong market-connectivity measures.

- A-share close: ChiNext jumped 5.64% as computing hardware, component and CPO/PCB names exploded higher; the midday print was already up 4.83%. [A-share close](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ycVNUWm5wOTV0WFhIeWU2M2VqQ2hvVHc3bENBdFQzQ203TmxLelJucFFiejBTRmk1cC1iNG1ydVZDdXVfZXU3YngxUVpfZXhwdG95Nm5EMFVfVkNFd3c), [midday](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9aVS0yRUhiTEpWb1VkeWdXWE56QnhyZVFXdzljaGRfcTRRamNfcWNNMWd5bS1ETUhWeWczYVFXX05hX2JGbDhXLUVON3JOWTZ6Z2xtbC1vXzN6VElVa0E)
- The reversal comes after a 14% drop in outstanding margin financing in July and a rough session on Aug 3 when the global AI selloff hammered the chip supply chain. [SCMP margin](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362797/china-stock-traders-cut-leveraged-positions-14-july-amid-tech-sell), [ETEnterprise](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiygFBVV95cUxPQko2ZG9peEptOFNJM3BSYm1rNkc0SkZYZHd4VUh0eENrN2hEX2lGMzlhaW1GUVN0R19NQTZQWWJmQ1RIdVg4cENlZ1luX1dua0NUeWhzVVVuX1BRVlRULVNsc1RxVnN6Vm44SmpHUEhlUUYzLWx4NHpwRFZQX0x6LTItMmdvT0RVeXlhQUJkRVlZYUFHU24xMkZiYThHaFRHLXVUcFhRRzhmQm9SalRqVnJIX3NvblViaGZRT3c5TzFWUFE5VUdjaE13)
- Hong Kong connectivity is deepening: HKEX launched a five-year CGB futures contract, officials promised more mainland-HK capital-market measures, and China's mBridge CBDC network is positioning itself as a cheaper cross-border settlement alternative to SWIFT. [HKEX](https://news.google.), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE1wdWU2dlJ2RXpZdXBtZlJuUnE4ZThiVmpMZTRROE9kb2NBaXFKdWcwbXBMVXdhU1lLbjJpYTVHZnBmZXpEUEVEdjlXbWhWdlRYX2ZsVFRmakF4MVNJcm5PUllnN0RTZ0dSc29OTVpCa3JQNnVoZzZBeVFVZ2U), [mBridge](https://news.google.)
- HSBC resumed buybacks with a $1bn programme, and WuXi AppTec posted a 33.7% rise in interim net profit despite US scrutiny, showing strength in pharma and banking. [SCMP HSBC](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362872/hsbc-sets-aside-us1-billion-first-share-buy-back-october), [SCMP WuXi](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362817/chinese-biotech-giant-wuxi-apptec-sees-first-half-earnings-surge-amid-us-scrutiny)
- Chinese EV sales faltered in July, reigniting fears of price wars, while multinationals like Coca-Cola and Unilever still posted strong China H1 sales; Goldman Sachs argues China's commodities footprint is cushioning global energy shocks. [SCMP EV](https://www.scmp.com/plus/business/china-evs/article/3362799/chinese-ev-sales-falter-home-growth-slows), [SCMP MNC](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362787/multinational-giants-defy-chinas-sluggish-retail-market-strong-2026-sales), [SCMP Goldman](https://www.scmp.com/business/commodities/article/3362861/chinas-outsize-commodities-footprint-cushions-global-energy-shocks-goldman-sachs)

Signal to watch: the 5.64% ChiNext rebound is the clearest test of whether Beijing's policy support can override global tech deleveraging - the next session will show if it was a short squeeze or a real turn.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
概览：社区资讯覆盖央行流动性操作、上市公司公告与商品市场微观数据，为投资者提供决策参考。

- 央行8月4日开展了465亿元7天期逆回购操作，维护银行体系流动性合理充裕，释放跨月后呵护信号。[央行](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBGUThOUDBLUmhtOTYwNmFrMUtMNUNhRTNFeFM5ajI2aEZyZUt2QVhXR1luZk5KeVRlYUVLNUhvVThRWmhpem1oLVo3SV9kX2YtdFhWWHBlLWlJa0pmQ2c)
- 燕麦科技实控人向哈工大基金会无偿捐赠市值超4000万元的公司股份，兼顾公益与股权安排；海康威视发布满足HJ 1480-2026标准的排污监测专用产品，切入环保数字化新场景。[燕麦](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5CM2hVXy1TVURMNXhnbWxjWU8xcW50NUs0WTJCS2FhQUtFamRhNW96VnI5YkdKUmJrQTZ1WWVKNWFMaUtRaVBwM0IyU2NMYkVwMFFQY1R0WW5IcWtlZ0dzYTJ3)[海康](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE93VVBZYllUXzJwQXliQ1pxV0hjdFdhelpKZUMweUtuZldzYXpDWFBBRnlkVHBGWmNxMHBVNS11R1RoZFFnVHZVbmpzMzYyX2V6cTRTX1RNTGJ3cTFLNE5qbXJn)
- 福元医药两款药品拟中选第十二批全国药品集中采购，有望以量换价；深圳能源融资余额为5.3亿元，较前一交易日减少0.02亿元，近期出现2个连续融资净买入后获利了结迹象。[福元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE83ZTFOMnk5aFNWZVQtbkU5SGlSbG5TUnN2dGQ1Q2tFdm9UUDJOdkJkMXcyVUtLdFBUN1dWYjBMS1RTTl81N1pKZTJLTzlfVkdBM25QNVdadk1nMmM5b2pYS1Jn)[深圳能源](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFBOamhHcU8wOV9reXowczVPdWlicFFVc2pjNzBlNmRzTUpmLVZKYS1BY3QtTVZWZTFYNGxZNG1HT3BkVGtpY1RfbGE4b1VCTkVMZWE1M3Q4N3RHcHB1bjJON0w3cw)
- 商品方面，8月3日各地区早稻现货价格汇总出炉，郑商所瓶片期货仓单较上一日增加99张，为农产品和化工品交易者提供及时数据。[现货](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9lRXJRaFNCYkhHQWp6LTZ0VzFTVThmWjNlcmdRaktTWkEzUU05RjkwUFpwVkpQQTQ4V2ZnazlPMEZCZWdaM2NkQzJWN1d3T096UUt4ajZrQkhzVlZNME9DOWpn)[仓单](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9vdk1OQjY3cjN0ZWdNZHh5OHdERFZNXzZkYm1iRE9fR3BxbW5OaFJzOGZXcl9OR3pEYlhpSnVYY0pkNWMzQWhJYy01ZTVHRlNrbHdiSlBhaXh5ZUxrYVNCMGl3)

收束：社区层面的公告密集但主线清晰：流动性政策平稳、公司基本面与合规动作并重，商品仓单变化则预示着短线交易热点。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Retail community sentiment has turned aggressively risk-on after Tuesday's A-share surge, with the main focus on PBoC liquidity and AI-hardware leadership. The reverse-repo operation was read as a signal that policymakers want to keep funding conditions easy.

- The PBoC conducted 46.5 billion yuan of 7-day reverse repos on Aug 4, a liquidity move closely tracked by retail traders. [10jqka](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBGUThOUDBLUmhtOTYwNmFrMUtMNUNhRTNFeFM5ajI2aEZyZUt2QVhXR1luZk5KeVRlYUVLNUhvVThRWmhpem1oLVo3SV9kX2YtdFhWWHBlLWlJa0pmQ2c)
- Community posts highlighted ChiNext surging 5.64% at the close, with 'computing hardware stocks collectively erupting'; the midday update showed the rally building from an earlier 4.83% gain. [close](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE5ycVNUWm5wOTV0WFhIeWU2M2VqQ2hvVHc3bENBdFQzQ203TmxLelJucFFiejBTRmk1cC1iNG1ydVZDdXVfZXU3YngxUVpfZXhwdG95Nm5EMFVfVkNFd3c), [midday](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE9aVS0yRUhiTEpWb1VkeWdXWE56QnhyZVFXdzljaGRfcTRRamNfcWNNMWd5bS1ETUhWeWczYVFXX05hX2JGbDhXLUVON3JOWTZ6Z2xtbC1vXzN6VElVa0E)
- Corporate news is driving niche interest: Hikvision released a new HJ 1480-2026-compliant monitoring camera system for pollution-source self-monitoring, and Fuyuan Pharma said two drugs were selected for the 12th national centralized drug procurement. [Hikvision](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE93VVBZYllUXzJwQXliQ1pxV0hjdFdhelpKZUMweUtuZldzYXpDWFBBRnlkVHBGWmNxMHBVNS11R1RoZFFnVHZVbmpzMzYyX2V6cTRTX1RNTGJ3cTFLNE5qbXJn), [Fuyuan](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE83ZTFOMnk5aFNWZVQtbkU5SGlSbG5TUnN2dGQ1Q2tFdm9UUDJOdkJkMXcyVUtLdFBUN1dWYjBMS1RTTl81N1pKZTJLTzlfVkdBM25QNVdadk1nMmM5b2pYS1Jn)
- Retail commodity desks were also active: early rice spot prices were posted for Aug 3, and Zhengzhou Commodity Exchange bottle-pet warehouse receipts rose by 99 lots. [early rice](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9lRXJRaFNCYkhHQWp6LTZ0VzFTVThmWjNlcmdRaktTWkEzUU05RjkwUFpwVkpQQTQ4V2ZnazlPMEZCZWdaM2NkQzJWN1d3T096UUt4ajZrQkhzVlZNME9DOWpn), [bottle PET](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9vdk1OQjY3cjN0ZWdNZHh5OHdERFZNXzZkYm1iRE9fR3BxbW5OaFJzOGZXcl9OR3pEYlhpSnVYY0pkNWMzQWhJYy01ZTVHRlNrbHdiSlBhaXh5ZUxrYVNCMGl3)
- The community is leaning bullish on AI-hardware names but remains sensitive to policy liquidity signals; the 46.5bn yuan reverse-repo operation is being treated as a soft floor under the market. [10jqka reverse repo](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBGUThOUDBLUmhtOTYwNmFrMUtMNUNhRTNFeFM5ajI2aEZyZUt2QVhXR1luZk5KeVRlYUVLNUhvVThRWmhpem1oLVo3SV9kX2YtdFhWWHBlLWlJa0pmQ2c)

欧美.zh:
欧美媒体头条仍被外部冲突占据，欧洲本土的干旱与野火也发出民生警报。

- [昂山素季](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c1e1d5j6660o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：军政府放行红十字会探视，照片显示她健康，家属称看到希望；但信息由官方发布，需独立核验。
- [加沙](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/palestine-weekly-israel-kills-dozens-in-gaza-after-hamas-disarmament-deal?traffic_source=rss)：哈马斯解除武装协议签署后，以军空袭反致数十人死亡；以方称不解除武装不撤军，协议未缓解人道危机。
- [俄乌](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr7kmnyrdn7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：乌无人机袭击俄黑海海滩，包括儿童在内7死40伤。平民伤亡凸显战争残酷，也压缩外交空间。
- [欧洲干旱](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78gn8zvrx4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss)：莱茵河等水位创新低，航运与水电承压。气候问题正变成经济硬约束。

收束：冲突与气候正抢占公共议程，名人八卦退居次席。
欧美.en:
The Europe-Americas desk is dominated by conflict and instability: a US-brokered Gaza plan has not produced quiet, Russia is blaming Ukraine for a deadly beach strike, and Europe's migration and climate pressures are converging on the EU agenda. Aung San Suu Kyi's first verified outside contact offers a rare humanitarian data point inside Myanmar's junta story.

- **Gaza ceasefire fiction?** Israeli strikes killed dozens after the Hamas disarmament deal, and the Board of Peace said no Israeli withdrawal would occur before disarmament. The sequence means the 'breakthrough' has not changed violence on the ground, and the disarmament roadmap is already contested. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/palestine-weekly-israel-kills-dozens-in-gaza-after-hamas-disarmament-deal?traffic_source=rss), [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/8/4/board-of-peace-says-no-israeli-withdrawal-from-gaza-before-hamas-disarms?traffic_source=rss))
- **Deadly beach strike**: Russia said a Ukrainian drone killed seven and injured 40 at a Black Sea resort, with three children among the dead. Without independent verification, the event is already a propaganda flashpoint; if confirmed, it broadens the war's civilian footprint far from the front. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cr7kmnyrdn7o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **EU borders**: Ursula von der Leyen demanded stronger borders after Ceuta migrant crossings, with EU interior ministers called to an urgent meeting. This will revive intra-EU fights over responsibility-sharing and border enforcement. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cyvl84zmgyro?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Drought and ordnance**: The Rhine hit a record low, with the Danube and Po also strained, reducing freight capacity and hydroelectric output; wildfires in Le Porge, France, exposed hundreds of WW2 shells. Climate risk is becoming physical security and energy risk simultaneously. ([BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c78gn8zvrx4o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss), [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cgmkxjrrwdvo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss))
- **Markets, Iran and Trump**: U.S. stocks hovered near record highs and oil fell after Trump claimed Iran talks were under way, but Tehran says it is only talking to Oman. The mixed signals create volatility risk for energy prices. ([Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/economy/2026/8/4/us-stocks-near-record-high-oil-falls-as-trump-claims-iran-talks-underway?traffic_source=rss))

**Signal**: Watch whether Gaza violence forces a public renegotiation of the disarmament deal, and whether the EU emergency meeting can agree on any operational border measure, not just a statement.

日韩.zh:
日韩关系仍处政冷经热与民意微妙变动中：官方因独岛交锋，民间好感度却创历史新高；熊本地震则让产业停摆持续发酵。

- [独岛争议与民意分化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE84cHJEUldfaE5zTXlDMnBUWkRWM2JEMURUclRyNkZHOFEzbXBzeVhnNkJNWDVWazQ0dklFNEdQQnBhdXEtTUNGWGZwa1hZUEpMQUVJNDFzMHo1Zw)：韩国外交部抗议日本再次主张独岛主权，要求撤回；但同期民调显示韩国人对日好感度达54.3%，创新高。外交争端与民间情绪背离，说明关系改善的基础不牢。
- [韩国重启捕鲸](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNeDU3ZTBIaGtOZkZvWE5VQmhkeE81YVdFUldhaW5FRFF1RFM0UFNkdWpUTC0zd2JsMVFWRk1rdkpZSE1keVZjNnpvblNQTlhwSy0wcHB4X3hJb2hLejRSWXV2QTR6SVQ4TXNJenFYQXkxaFFhWkpFeERkVk9XUUxuakJhLThtZ0wtU2lnc3Vla25OMEhJemx2eXlWY3BKdElNSS11a3VB)：继日本之后，韩国被曝恢复商业捕鲸，遭环保组织谴责，可能引发国际抵制，也暴露传统产业与国际规则的两难。
- [熊本地震余波](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOQ2l6RHpyN1RYcFpSLXgtS2xZSWZFMFlXejJBUTlCSEV4ZEZmQ2tISDRYZDNhRlRqcTlNSnN2c0wydmtldDN5VFEzekJKeWlzUHdxUWgydGdOV3JGUlY5M2Y2aGR2dEZKR2d2RTcybm8xVlVkeHJkWFdBcHBnb3BOX3NwaF9Xci02MzJ2RXlsWFhHYTVHNHA5WmlqRlhtZlk)：多家车企延长熊本工厂停产，供应链压力蔓延；高市早苗赴灾区视察，政治人物开始介入。
- [首尔高温](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9YVU9pQnc4NVlINTJxa0Qyc2VnYXRldmd6ajdRSGJhUUNLRU95LXN5TnV0R0dhSE83YlBSeUJLXzdDVzhoNE1FbzRESk9ZN0dOMGZST0ZGaw)：首尔都市圈发布最高级别高温预警，直接威胁户外劳动者健康，也推高用电负荷。

收束：日韩社会在安全、民生与身份认同上同时承压，动向值得持续跟踪。
日韩.en:
The Japan-Korea desk is a split-screen: diplomatic friction with Japan is high, yet South Korean public favorability toward Japan has never been higher; North Korea is escalating rhetoric over RIMPAC; and domestic shocks—heat, quake, and whaling—are creating new political risk. State-to-state disputes remain live even as opinion polls improve.

- **Dokdo dispute**: South Korea 'strongly' protested Japan's renewed claim to Dokdo and demanded immediate withdrawal. The timing, soon after record-friendly polling, shows territorial nationalism remains separate from public sentiment. ([Yonhap](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE84cHJEUldfaE5zTXlDMnBUWkRWM2JEMURUclRyNkZHOFEzbXBzeVhnNkJNWDVWazQ0dklFNEdQQnBhdXEtTUNGWGZwa1hZUEpMQUVJNDFzMHo1Zw))
- **Record favorability**: 54.3% of South Koreans now view Japan favorably, according to a poll. This shift matters for future cooperation, but it did not prevent the latest Dokdo protest. ([Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipwFBVV95cUxNNmtsT2t5Y1RuYWNSWHdyby1sWW16R3N1a01xZWJPLUZONHJuaGQzYVozZmpSQ2luLXZ0S0F0U0NPM19ieURFbGc2dUxtQWo0d3pZQU1jR3N4MVZoSWU5bHRaMDNVYTlTZ2MtRzF5R0x6Z2Nnal9mSDRnbnh1LWJySDJOZUJBMmFWb1N4RUt1djF4aXJMVWhxc3V0aDV0RVprZXZqemwxbw), [Seoul Economic Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQdWxDdDk2SUpTWEFLTUE0V0lFTHRTazBERUstR1BHcjB2THdrVlRWSG5XdFRDWDgySzhYWktQU0locm5LTWRxdlZlNmZmNnNRWUcxUWpvaVJBUF9RUUdkdlg5Y092dXVxa3BJS3F3bmZXcFhLazFyZVc3dTVpcHpOTjlXd2VPTkM2N3Q5Y1VpOFltbVZPZXM2b1dldVgtaUUwODJr))
- **North Korean deterrence threat**: North Korea threatened a 'new level of deterrence' over South Korea's leading role in RIMPAC. With combat drones also central to Japan's defense adaptation, military signaling is rising across the region. ([Aju Press](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5tQm54cWEySGd6WndWcTF1bHAxQkhjbjk5Z1JsWC1fdklqSElHRE1oSGVjeHdCWUZWcnVqUjJKcC02d1lDSGFXdDRhbUVRaDhkUHRwYXJFNNIBV0FVX3lxTE5tQm54cWEySGd6WndWcTF1bHAxQkhjbjk5Z1JsWC1fdklqSElHRE1oSGVjeHdCWUZWcnVqUjJKcC02d1lDSGFXdDRhbUVRaDhkUHRwYXJFNA), [New Indian Express](https://news.google.))
- **Whaling returns**: South Korea, following Japan, has resumed whaling, prompting environmentalist anger. This could damage Korea's international reputation and become a diplomatic vulnerability with Western allies. ([AsiaNews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMipgFBVV95cUxNeDU3ZTBIaGtOZkZvWE5VQmhkeE81YVdFUldhaW5FRFF1RFM0UFNkdWpUTC0zd2JsMVFWRk1rdkpZSE1keVZjNnpvblNQTlhwSy0wcHB4X3hJb2hLejRSWXV2QTR6SVQ4TXNJenFYQXkxaFFhWkpFeERkVk9XUUxuakJhLThtZ0wtU2lnc3Vla25OMEhJemx2eXlWY3BKdElNSS11a3VB))
- **Heat and quake recovery**: The highest-level heat wave warning was issued for Greater Seoul, while automakers extended plant suspensions after the Kumamoto earthquake and PM Takaichi visited victims. These events compound supply-chain and public-health stress. ([Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9YVU9pQnc4NVlINTJxa0Qyc2VnYXRldmd6ajdRSGJhUUNLRU95LXN5TnV0R0dhSE83YlBSeUJLXzdDVzhoNE1FbzRESk9ZN0dOMGZST0ZGaw), [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxOQ2l6RHpyN1RYcFpSLXgtS2xZSWZFMFlXejJBUTlCSEV4ZEZmQ2tISDRYZDNhRlRqcTlNSnN2c0wydmtldDN5VFEzekJKeWlzUHdxUWgydGdOV3JGUlY5M2Y2aGR2dEZKR2d2RTcybm8xVlVkeHJkWFdBcHBnb3BOX3NwaF9Xci02MzJ2RXlsWFhHYTVHNHA5WmlqRlhtZlk), [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxOejl5S1VWZ3E2T3hDaG4ySGV6YVhZNXF1eS16M2xPbTZ3d1FoNlRWTXI2clJNS1QzN1BQcl91NzB1dVFldTIwTUZUWlJJaUptZXJ0SUhaaV9IbGZFNHNCelhYaWpJVjRQQUV1SC1LQVNwWTE4TlltdUpaTWNGam8xaQ))

**Signal**: Watch whether North Korea's RIMPAC threat translates into missile or satellite launches, and whether the Dokdo protest slows the improved public mood or remains a ritualized diplomatic objection.

中国.zh:
今日中国板块以权威媒体的解析性报道为主，未见突发性社会事件；但高校决算、AI治理、公共卫生分析等条目具有实际信息增量。

- [高校决算公布](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE90SjhQSkJGb3ZSRmVBSDRQNTZ5RVVBWG51SWFVTmRXTDVlNjZjRWFJeWUtbVBaOU1ULVpyQU1DME9sOGtJS3BkVXBPa2xFUzE0Nk5HNEhJZXZhM0J5NFZkUFRHUmZaa0Y1aE40)：教育部直属高校2025年部门决算集中公开，涉及经费收支全貌。这是观察高等教育资源分配和财务透明度的关键窗口。
- [AI全球治理](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNdW1jN3dnWHZfbEVmY2dETHBqdkRtMnNxWS1CeFBhMDE0MVZuZXlpNWQ5RG9PcEtRdlZCakZvcUw5YTN2ckpOVWJzOFNjb180ZGNSWjNpZXZVTU1YbTZnWTE3VFdpZC0ybXVFdHNYclg5UVdfcS15d3VZT25lMVVDbXZuZi12QQ)：新华社刊文讨论人工智能全球治理难题，点出技术扩散与监管竞争之间的张力。在各国加快立法的背景下，中国官方的表态具有政策风向标意义。
- [埃博拉疫情分析](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQY3d3MXZxclVjMDQ2TzEwa01BRlk0WFNMcUtVQmFWM0RudHFxX1dRWUU3d2VaQ09kS1VsX0NiY01SdUhFU0N0LWlVbktVdTJIUU5YYVRUM01LNHpIaTJCZ0tvNFJ5MzlUYW0taFBVZG1OQzRocVd0aDJ5Wk9BaUZzbEl2M0VMUQ)：文章梳理非洲埃博拉反复暴发的原因，凸显公共卫生体系脆弱性，也关联中国海外公共卫生合作的可能空间。

收束：中国板块缺乏突发冲突，但制度性、技术性议题集中出现，提示“社会”的定义正在被算法与公共卫生等新变量拓展。
中国.en:
The China desk's 23 items are overwhelmingly republished from state and university-affiliated outlets, with little independent social reporting. The main themes are official foreign-affairs commentary, technology governance, education outreach, and ideological culture; the desk is best read as a signal of official priorities rather than as breaking news. Naphtha shortages in Japan and Ebola in Africa are covered as external affairs from a Chinese perspective.

- **Foreign politics via Xinhua**: Xinhua ran profiles of France's far-right building toward the 2027 presidential election and Britain's Burnham as a 'prime minister road' for the north. These choices suggest Chinese state media is tracking European populist and regional realignments closely. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPN1NYRFNvZk5lR0FNa05OYVFUU0NvSmEzR2wweUtxbGc4VjdYMUZadFZzbE9CWnVmVGM3MmthZGRBVEJfdVdOVGlqZ3V6TnQ0b216OTNSUTBidDhXM1BuN3VXOFk1N29BMGkyeW1ueks1NFFiRENGRi1IY3FnM0piN3I0djNOQQ), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNVWVwUzAxeURiVlZWbm9TbWxwS281ajF5NFc0eENIRXBZR1ZnWHgwQ3BjVnVWNWhtLWJidzV5R19TUkYzbDQzZW9xRmk4M0JTMEVkclQ2aDJVTmxRWkpSWWJDMUhPb2YxT0Z5UGl4cktpQU1HNFJObk0yNV9ZUnBiei0tS2EtUQ))
- **AI governance line**: A Xinhua commentary on responding to global AI governance challenges signals Beijing's preferred framing of multilateral rules and state oversight ahead of international AI debates. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNdW1jN3dnWHZfbEVmY2dETHBqdkRtMnNxWS1CeFBhMDE0MVZuZXlpNWQ5RG9PcEtRdlZCakZvcUw5YTN2ckpOVWJzOFNjb180ZGNSWjNpZXZVTU1YbTZnWTE3VFdpZC0ybXVFdHNYclg5UVdfcS15d3VZT25lMVVDbXZuZi12QQ))
- **Ebola and external affairs**: Xinhua's explainer on why Ebola outbreaks recur in Africa frames China as a public-health commentator for the Global South, an area where Chinese aid and messaging increasingly overlap. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxQY3d3MXZxclVjMDQ2TzEwa01BRlk0WFNMcUtVQmFWM0RudHFxX1dRWUU3d2VaQ09kS1VsX0NiY01SdUhFU0N0LWlVbktVdTJIUU5YYVRUM01LNHpIaTJCZ0tvNFJ5MzlUYW0taFBVZG1OQzRocVd0aDJ5Wk9BaUZzbEl2M0VMUQ))
- **Education and grassroots mobilization**: Education items show a consistent pattern: Beihang's science camp in Lvliang, Hefei's smart-transport program for international students, and Sichuan agriculture students visiting Chongqing 'red' sites. These are soft-power and STEM-education signals, not news events. ([Beihang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE9HczJkTTVZZE9lOG1ubE5rUzdkRzRhS3RSWm96RERlVDNvSFJpSGZLdFJqNkkzMVVhRm9oNGZjS3dsZzA3V0hHLUpuWWl5OXpaMVJUMFlUMA), [Hefei](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE54dFI2TllKWmcwZm1OaUdZZkoyWnNkdEFYTG5sd1prV2ZMNXVVLW93ZUo4eW55LTB1T2thczlSWWVVM1pKc1FVOTJJdWlYVm1RcnBGay1PYw), [Sichuan Agricultural University](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE56c0VTVXNsOXpLVmZVU2d4MUxVUXdyMjJ1eXFfX1VybVFhRlVfdXFZTEpGVXozYXhySGZMYmNUelRNcGVNeFFwUU9RWFdsMlpfWWNjUlRlZDk5UQ))
- **Culture as diplomacy**: Xinhua's 'when the world begins to borrow Chinese culture' and the exhibit of artist Liang Yonghe at the Water Cube emblemize the official assertion of Chinese cultural influence. ([Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxNVVhxS1lpMkQyM1NsRkpXd19tY21vNlJQY1JiUWk3aTktTXFjNzJaWVd1NVBYTjNJR0xfTTZtSDBXS3RFS0wzcV9XUnJWZHZab0pYUTBMUV9pRWlFS0UwYjZ0WEZfOG9SZUdXa1RrZTV6UzBhYzdNbG8xalRxNlFIWFFpd1dtUQ), [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxPbUFPSFA5Tm5BSEVkUGpFS01vOWV2b0piT3E1TWM3Wm1UTTRBaUZBbEoxdW5TdFdxME5wdXR1ckdIZ1pTekkwYkVBWGhKUDBuam9MTzN5SXNOdXpJMmdZU1c1N2ZuY3Y3RFhpSV9RRmNYUmVDWG4yMFRsUVZibnlnR3pKeGstZw))

**Signal**: The absence of domestic social-issue reporting in this desk is itself notable; expect more official commentary on AI governance and foreign election dynamics as Beijing positions its media for 2026 geopolitical milestones.

知乎社区动态.zh:
过去24小时，该子专栏几乎被TGBUS发布的博彩导流文章淹没。这些标题打着“鸿蒙6福利”“知乎严选年卡免费领”旗号，实际指向188BET、星空体育、196vip等境外博彩平台，属于典型的黑灰产内容营销。真正的社区动态只有两条。

- [以福利为饵的博彩广告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE9va0xrVWNQckNnVUxVQXQ5bnB4VDVnZ2djNmkwcHRwam9kS1ZxNzZfOHZra2NfT0VJdW5NN0cwZ0t6dU5kUm5JX0tGVzVranl6eVE)：TGBUS批量发布“鸿蒙6福利”文章，诱导用户点击后跳转至“开yun体育”等博彩平台，并搭配“知乎严选年卡免费领”话术增强可信度。这类内容污染信息流，也使用户面临财产安全风险。
- [知乎-W董事会会议](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1leGtoQ1RBZ3ZOZjVJQ2d3U3YtMGwtRUd5SVY0TjFnM1NEUmNydEktYnZoOGVyajZGYkxfdW1uRkNpOUg0bEZBTlhNbHgxaFlndklNM3NubHp6VHdiMDNDNS01eXJrRjRRUFUxYVlLcWw0RHF5YnJSTk1n)：知乎（ZHIHU-W）公告将召开董事会会议，市场或等待财报及重大事项信号。这是少数与公司治理直接相关的动态。
- [TechFlow情报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE41eXJJbTdQSFNtN1hHNEZVVnBFQU5Pandsc3c1MG9BaWZUV3VSM1d1RllXZ3N3TUp0ZVV6aUE1Z00xMWx4eVozUGZuVVZLQWFPNGdURw)：提到阿里通义千问3.8 Max在国产代码模型评测中登顶，以及币安下架六个币种。该信息或与AI、Web3话题联动，但被广告噪声挤压。

收束：“知乎社区动态”栏目被垃圾内容占据，本身就是平台治理信号；建议读者勿点击来历不明的“福利”链接，期待平台强化反垃圾机制。
知乎社区动态.en:
The Zhihu community-dynamics desk is not currently reporting actual community discussion; it has been turned into a distribution channel for gambling and spam content. Eight items include seven near-identical TGBUS links using 'HarmonyOS 6' and 'Zhihu Select annual card free' language to direct users to sports-betting platforms. One legitimate corporate notice and a tech roundup round out the feed.

- **Spam pattern**: TGBUS posts repeatedly pair Zhihu's brand with gambling platforms such as 188BET, hga050, 196vip, and u-ball, offering 'free' annual cards through phone home-screen events. This is coordinated paid content or SEO abuse, and it is contaminating the Zhihu desk. ([TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTE9va0xrVWNQckNnVUxVQXQ5bnB4VDVnZ2djNmkwcHRwam9kS1ZxNzZfOHZra2NfT0VJdW5NN0cwZ0t6dU5kUm5JX0tGVzVranl6eVE), [TGBUS variant](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1xa0x0TGduZnc1WUZOOGRnV0ZKb0RTTEpVYnJpZUUxRzYwTS1MS0cyWGI4bUhGellkM2kwS2RUTy1HVENzbkFqb0NXdTBycktxQWNfdWYyWlRPUjMxeEE))
- **Brand-abuse risk**: The repeated 'Zhihu Select annual card free' promise is likely a hook to farm installs or logins; it is a trust and compliance problem for any official channel that aggregates this feed. ([TGBUS](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE9wM3BEdV9VcUFOVTc2NTBjbVVlOEtuSU5YVkNmN0hYTmVpNm9CQzJleVJrQWZ2NWlDa290VVZVUWYwRU53VEFwOVRvUndvNXNmVEZMWVR1eFF1dw))
- **Actual corporate news**: Zhihu-W announced the date of its board meeting, a standard but real governance event ahead of likely earnings. ([Futu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiekFVX3lxTE1leGtoQ1RBZ3ZOZjVJQ2d3U3YtMGwtRUd5SVY0TjFnM1NEUmNydEktYnZoOGVyajZGYkxfdW1uRkNpOUg0bEZBTlhNbHgxaFlndklNM3NubHp6VHdiMDNDNS01eXJrRjRRUFUxYVlLcWw0RHF5YnJSTk1n))
- **Tech/AI context**: A TechFlow post highlighted Alibaba's Tongyi Qianwen 3.8 Max ranking first among domestic code models and Binance delisting six tokens; these are the kind of topics that would normally generate actual Zhihu discussion. ([TechFlow](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTE41eXJJbTdQSFNtN1hHNEZVVnBFQU5Pandsc3c1MG9BaWZUV3VSM1d1RllXZ3N3TUp0ZVV6aUE1Z00xMWx4eVozUGZuVVZLQWFPNGdURw))

**Signal**: Unless platform moderation removes this TGBUS spam, the Zhihu community-dynamics desk will continue to erode trust and mislead readers into gambling sites; monitor whether Zhihu or Google News blocks these sources.

国际安全.zh:
**概览**：国际安全领域呈现“中东热战外溢、印太兵力前推、欧洲军备承压”的三线挤压态势。美军航母动态与红海护航机制调整，是判断未来一周局势走向的两个关键观测窗口。

- 美军航母“乔治·华盛顿”号访问越南，为2023年以来首次，同时两艘航母在阿拉伯海执行封锁任务，显示[美军在全球两个高危方向同时投入航母力量](https://www.twz.com/sea/where-are-the-aircraft-carriers-august-3-2026)。
- 沙特组建红海多国防务联盟，正值美国-伊朗冲突威胁全球航运，[海湾安全秩序正从“美国单保”转向“区域多边+外部支援”混合模式](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzYW5GeThZRVRJOEdQWURFYXR4UjNLSEF6ZnpRQTJPSTVUWV84TWlXNEhnWTF0YXNvVEVWRDNscC1RcE1MSXYzYW5yc09ERzZiWVRteXMtVnVNQlhKSXBR)。
- 美国空军B-52升级计划被曝超支数十亿美元，[70年机龄轰炸机的现代化成本正在吞噬美空军预算弹性](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQLXUzUG5YQVRvSmJzdjFPLV83bldqWTU2eUJHd2VWakVGV1ZaT2NLRS1pZzZJNzBkTW1VajJ4RUF5Zkl5V3BYeUt2NVYxUVVBUXdtbU82ZTRqSG9DZml0bVJpTXlJMFk0SnVIVzlhTVhYZHB6MnJ4Q2pkcEZBNWZsZmd5bkdTSDZmMTVqeHRGYUFDYjJXU2NWUjZMREJEUFZaZ0c0)。
- 莱茵金属发布GMF 140护卫舰，整合美制雷达、垂发与宙斯盾系统，[直接瞄准北美下一代水面舰艇竞标](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-new-guided-missile-frigate-projected-for-north-american-tender/)。

**收束**：国际安全议题正被“两个战场”（东欧与中东）和“两个军种”（空军与海军）的预算竞争重新定义，未来数月美欧军费分配将出现明显博弈。
国际安全.en:
Military-industrial and force-design news over the past day points to a US-led rethink around missile defense, deep-strike magazines, and space-based surveillance. The Navy’s reclassification of Virginia-class submarines as SSGNs and Rheinmetall’s frigate entry into North America both respond to the same operating reality: conventional strike capacity is scarce and must be distributed across sea, land, and space.

- [Stretched Virginia Class Recategorized As Guided Missile Submarines (SSGNs)](https://www.twz.com/sea/stretched-virginia-class-recategorized-as-guided-missile-submarines-ssgns) — Enlarged Block V/VI Virginias will no longer be counted as attack submarines; they are positioned as SSGNs to take over the Ohio-class cruise-missile mission as those boats retire.
- [Rheinmetall unveils new guided-missile frigate projected for North American tender](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/rheinmetall-unveils-new-guided-missile-frigate-projected-for-north-american-tender/) — The German GMF 140 offers AEGIS, 64 strike-length VLS cells, US radar options, and hypersonic/ballistic missile integration, aimed at Canada’s (and possibly US) surface combatant market.
- [The US Air Force’s plan to upgrade its 70-year-old B-52 bombers is billions over budget, watchdog finds](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiowFBVV95cUxQLXUzUG5YQVRvSmJzdjFPLV83bldqWTU2eUJHd2VWakVGV1ZaT2NLRS1pZzZJNzBkTW1VajJ4RUF5Zkl5V3BYeUt2NVYxUVVBUXdtbU82ZTRqSG9DZml0bVJpTXlJMFk0SnVIVzlhTVhYZHB6MnJ4Q2pkcEZBNWZsZmd5bkdTSDZmMTVqeHRGYUFDYjJXU2NWUjZMREJEUFZaZ0c0) — The overrun threatens the bomber fleet’s radar/engine modernization and forces difficult choices before the next budget cycle.
- [K2 tapped to host Space Force satellite laser links tests](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/08/k2-tapped-to-host-space-force-satellite-laser-links-tests/) — Optical intersatellite links are central to Golden Dome missile tracking; K2 will host test nodes, validating a sensor-to-shooter chain that could determine homeland-defense timelines.
- [Northrop Grumman to deliver advanced simulation and threat modeling for Missile Defense Agency](https://news.google.) — MDA is investing in digital simulation to validate homeland defense and training missions amid hypersonic threat growth.

**Signal:** The through-line is clear — the Pentagon is reorganizing platforms and budgets around missile defense, deep-strike magazines, and resilient space-based sensing; expect program trade-offs in the FY27 budget.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览**：伊朗—乌克兰—美国三边互动出现“表面降级、深层未解”的局面。伊朗宣布取消对乌克兰的报复性打击，但霍尔木兹海峡商船遇袭、美伊谈判前景不明，以及红海护航联盟的成立，说明中东冲突的涟漪仍在扩大。

- 伊朗高级军事顾问称，因乌克兰就船只遇袭事件“道歉”，伊朗已取消对乌境内3处目标的打击计划；[Anadolu Ajansı对此有详细报道](https://news.google.)。《耶路撒冷邮报》也报道了同一消息，但[具体补偿/执行机制尚不清晰](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFA2M1FWSDJYbFUzVEMzZkZhYW92YlFmNVo2a0UyOENZc1hnejhnZm5kU0oyUnZONEhzcVVMYjBsN0dzV1ZuUFpLMG9QMGh1OGRGOXF0a2N5SFpyVk9hN19ZkZBOGV6cFVHVXc)。
- 美国与伊朗谈判状态仍不确定，[一艘商船在霍尔木兹海峡遇袭，凸显军事降级与政治谈判之间的脆弱平衡](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQSTBaSWFiRUJaTWM0U1VBbDRWcWpzQVF6ZlpjM3dpSVlHYkNaU09JTjRlY3BHQ3hfTDBSRVJNalRCYkRHdHJMMWR2TzNDZ0RvT2RiRk5Fd2FhdVhrMGw5VHNaVjJ1aE0zRVdHTkhrWkY1V0NvV3Q2TVJ5TnZIV3I0cGRjYW9NV2E4VmhtMGk0c2h2d29J)。
- 沙特组建红海多国防务联盟，[意味着中东安全主导权正出现“后美国时代”的区域自主化尝试](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTFAzYW5GeThZRVRJOEdQWURFYXR4UjNLSEF6ZnpRQTJPSTVUWV84TWlXNEhnWTF0YXNvVEVWRDNscC1RcE1MSXYzYW5yc09ERzZiWVRteXMtVnVNQlhKSXBR)。
- 分析指出[俄乌战争与伊朗战争存在“汇合”风险](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE5NTlJ6WE9YVHdnZjRaaGp4VU5Ma0FGeW5yZ2h1NS1IUTg0WFhta3JCb0pVNnpKRUk5TGpCbXozTEtpQnFyalBPQWpsZHp1eTNrWTlCdlV4cGFhYS1tSVpvdFQyREowVzVzZEJOSV8wRW5rMU4xVEZyaw)，乌克兰被指可能被“讨价还价”卷入美伊战争，[这一判断目前仍以假设性分析为主，尚缺官方证据](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNZ2pFalViYUVuZjdiZFFEd3VNb19Nak95NmI0WHBtMjh0SkxMV05fSU1zZWhIQkNlMnNQVFRkWWI5eUdoUjJ4VGxlTkltejN5U2VKRmQyUWNhRTE3dXNDVFVQT3BYalpzQnYyYS0wb1lHdUc4Zko0TGxtdG5KN2pucWNsTjRla1JtOHRKQkg1Y1pQdFo4bXhRcA)。

**收束**：伊朗“取消打击”更像一次战术性台阶，而非战略转向；霍尔木兹海峡与红海的双重紧张，意味着能源航运安全仍是未来数周冲突升级的最大触发器。
冲突局势.en:
The Iran crisis is in a strange hybrid phase: Tehran publicly says it backed down from striking Ukraine after a Kyiv apology, yet a ship was hit in the Strait of Hormuz and the status of US-Iran talks is unclear. The war is metastasizing regionally, with Saudi Arabia forming a Red Sea alliance and analysts warning of convergence between the Iran and Ukraine theaters.

- [Iran cancels planned strikes on Ukraine following Kyiv apology after ship attack](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiakFVX3lxTFA2M1FWSDJYbFUzVEMzZkZhYW92YlFmNVo2a0UyOENZc1hnejhnZm5kU0oyUnZONEhzcVVMYjBsN0dzV1ZuUFpLMG9QMGh1OGRGOXF0a2N5SFpyVk9hN19ZQkZBOGV6cFVHVXc) — The cancellation reportedly covered three planned strike sites; treat it cautiously — it may signal a diplomatic off-ramp or a deceptive de-escalation timed to talks.
- [Status of US-Iran talks uncertain as ship struck in Hormuz](https://news.google.) — A maritime attack in the Strait of Hormuz undermines any narrative of de-escalation and puts Gulf shipping lanes back at risk.
